name: sys_budget_sysmem
help: Sets the upper limit for system memory (in MB) when monitoring budget.

name: sys_budget_videomem
help: Sets the upper limit for video memory (in MB) when monitoring budget.

name: sys_budget_frametime
help: Sets the upper limit for frame time (in ms) when monitoring budget.

name: sys_budget_soundchannels
help: Sets the upper limit for sound channels playing when monitoring budget.

name: sys_budget_soundmem
help: Sets the upper limit for sound memory (in MB) when monitoring budget.

name: sys_budget_soundCPU
help: Sets the upper limit for sound CPU (in Percent) when monitoring budget.

name: sys_budget_numdrawcalls
help: Sets the upper limit for number of draw calls per frame.

name: sys_budget_numpolys
help: Sets the upper limit for number of polygons per frame.

name: sys_budget_streamingthroughput
help: Sets the upper limit for streaming throughput(KB/s).

name: wh_sys_DebugMouseEvents
help: Writes mouse events to console/log

name: sys_ime
help: 0 = IME disabled, 1 = IME enabled (if supported)

name: sys_MemoryDeadListSize
help: Keep upto size bytes in a "deadlist" of allocations to assist in capturing tramples

name: log_Verbosity
help:
defines the verbosity level for log messages written to console
-1=suppress all logs (including eAlways)
0=suppress all logs(except eAlways)
1=additional errors
2=additional warnings
3=additional messages
4=additional comments

name: log_Filter
help:
defines general filter for log events
log_Filter="Foo" - will only log events that matches this filter ("Foo")log_Filter="-Foo" - all events that matches this filter ("Foo") will be droppedlog_Filter="Foo|-Bar" - combine more filters

name: log_UseFilter
help: toggle to use filter (0=disabled, 1=filter console, 2=filter file, 3=filter console and file)

name: log_WriteToFile
help: toggle whether to write log to file (game.log)

name: log_WriteToFileVerbosity
help:
defines the verbosity level for log messages written to files
-1=suppress all logs (including eAlways)
0=suppress all logs(except eAlways)
1=additional errors
2=additional warnings
3=additional messages
4=additional comments

name: log_VerbosityOverridesWriteToFile
help: when enabled, setting log_verbosity to 0 will stop all logging including writing to file

name: log_IncludeTime
help:
Toggles time stamping of log entries.
Usage: log_IncludeTime [0/1/2/3/4/5]
  0=off (default)
  1=current time
  2=relative time
  3=current+relative time
  4=absolute time in seconds since this mode was started
  5=current time+server time

name: log_SpamDelay
help: Sets the minimum time interval between messages classified as spam

name: log_Module
help: Only show warnings from specified module

name: log_tick
help: When not 0, writes tick log entry into the log file, every N seconds

name: wh_sys_LogFlushInterval
help: Flush log to file every N seconds. 0 means flush every message, negative means flush never.

name: wh_sys_LogViewerRecording
help: Enable messages adding

name: wh_sys_LogViewerMode
help: [1] last messages, [2] messages from wh_sys_LogViewerStartLine, [3] Shift + PgUp/PgDown/Home/End changes wh_sys_LogViewerStartLine

name: wh_sys_LogViewerStartLine
help: Start line in modes 2 and 3

name: wh_sys_LogViewerLineCount
help: Line count, -1 means full screen

name: wh_sys_LogViewerFontSize
help: Size of font in pixels

name: wh_sys_PrecacheModeDebugDraw
help: Enables PrecacheMode debug

name: wh_sys_ReadinessObserverEnabled
help: Enables ReadinessObserver

name: wh_sys_ReadinessObserverTimeoutDuration
help: Max duration of ReadinessObserver in seconds

name: wh_sys_ReadinessObserverDebugDraw
help: Enables ReadinessObserver debug

name: wh_sys_ReadinessObserverProfiler
help: Enables ReadinessObserver profiler

name: wh_ui_ReadinessObserverProfilerSavePath
help: Directory path where profiling results are saved

name: wh_sys_ReadinessTaskProfiler
help: Shows Readiness Tasks in ReadinessProfiler and FaderProfiler

name: sys_flash
help: Enables/disables execution of flash files.

name: sys_flash_edgeaa
help: Enables/disables edge anti-aliased rendering of flash files.

name: sys_flash_log_options
help:
Enables logging of several flash related aspects (add them to combine logging)...
1) Flash loading                                                       : 1
2) Flash actions script execution                                      : 2
3) Flash related high-level calls inspected by the profiler (flash.log): 4
   Please note that for (3) the following cvars apply:
   * sys_flash_info
   * sys_flash_info_peak_exclude

name: sys_flash_curve_tess_error
help: Controls curve tessellation. Larger values result in coarser, more angular curves.

name: sys_flash_warning_level
help:
Sets verbosity level for CryEngine related warnings...
0) Omit warning
1) Log warning
2) Log warning and display message box

name: sys_flash_static_pool_size
help:
Specifies the size (in kb) of the static memory pool for flash objects.
Set to zero to turn it off and use a dynamic pool instead.

name: sys_flash_address_space
help: Specifies the size (in kilo bytes) of the address space used for flash objects.

name: sys_flash_allow_reset_mesh_cache
help: Allow programmatic mesh cache resets.

name: sys_flash_reset_mesh_cache
help: Reset mesh cache through console (once).

name: sys_flash_check_filemodtime
help:
Respect file modification time for Flash internal resource sharing.
Cached resources with same filepath but different file modification time are treated as unique entities.

name: sys_flash_frame_catchup_count
help: Maximum number of frames a movieclip can advance each frame.

name: wh_sys_flash_font_filename_suffix
help: Additional suffix for gfxfontlib.gfx and gfxfontlib_glyphs.gfx

name: sys_flash_use_arenas
help: Enables creation of Flash asset instances through designated memory arenas.

name: sys_ProsEnabled
help: PROS system enabled

name: sys_ProsLogLevel
help: PROS log level

name: log_EnableRemoteConsole
help: enables/disables the remote console

name: sys_flash_video_soundvolume
help: Sets volume of video's main sound track(0..1). Has no effect if video support is not compiled in.

name: sys_flash_video_subaudiovolume
help: Sets volume of video's sub audio sound track (0..1). Has no effect if video support is not compiled in.

name: sys_flash_video_buffertime
help: Sets buffer time for videos (in seconds)

name: sys_flash_video_buffertime_loading
help: Sets buffer time for videos during loading (in seconds)

name: sys_flash_video_buffertime_startup
help: Sets buffer time for videos during startup (in seconds)

name: sys_flash_debugdraw
help:
Enables debug drawing of Flash assets (1). Canvas area is drawn in bright green.
Also draw masks (2).

name: sys_flash_newstencilclear
help: Clears stencil buffer for mask rendering by drawing rects (1) as opposed to issuing clear commands (0)

name: sys_flash_stereo_maxparallax
help: Maximum parallax when viewing Flash content in stereo 3D

name: sys_audio_disable
help:
Specifies whether to use the NULLAudioSystem in place of the regular AudioSystem
Usage: sys_audio_disable [0/1]
0: use regular AudioSystem.
1: use NullAudioSystem (disable all audio functionality).
Default: 0 (enable audio functionality)

name: r_Width
help:
Sets the display width, in pixels.
Usage: r_Width [800/1024/..]

name: r_Height
help:
Sets the display height, in pixels.
Usage: r_Height [600/768/..]

name: r_NativeWidth
help:
Sets the output display width, in pixels if non-zero. Enables upscale/downscale from the base resolution.
Usage: r_Width [800/1024/..]

name: r_NativeHeight
help:
Sets the output display height, in pixels if non-zero. Enables upscale/downscale from the base resolution.
Usage: r_Height [600/768/..]

name: r_ColorBits
help:
Sets the color resolution, in bits per pixel. Default is 32.
Usage: r_ColorBits [32/24/16/8]

name: r_DepthBits
help:
Sets the depth precision, in bits per pixel. Default is 24.
Usage: r_DepthBits [32/24]

name: r_StencilBits
help: Sets the stencil precision, in bits per pixel. Default is 8.

name: r_overrideDXGIAdapter
help:
Specifies index of the preferred video adapter to be used for rendering (-1=off, loops until first suitable adapter is found).
Use this to resolve which video card to use if more than one DX11 capable GPU is available in the system.

name: r_Driver
help:
Sets the renderer driver ( DX11/AUTO/NULL ).
Specify in system.cfg like this: r_Driver = "DX11"

name: r_Fullscreen
help:
Toggles fullscreen mode. Default is 1 in normal game and 0 in DevMode.
Usage: r_Fullscreen [0=window/1=fullscreen]

name: r_FullscreenNativeRes
help:
Toggles native resolution upscaling.
If enabled, scene gets upscaled from specified resolution while UI is rendered in native resolution.

name: r_FullscreenWindow
help:
Toggles fullscreen-as-window mode. Fills screen but allows seamless switching. Default is 0.
Usage: r_FullscreenWindow [0=locked fullscreen/1=fullscreen as window]

name: r_DisplayInfo
help:
Toggles debugging information display.
Usage: r_DisplayInfo [0=off/1=show/2=enhanced/3=compact/4=cam pos]

name: r_OverscanBordersDrawDebugView
help:
Toggles drawing overscan borders.
Usage: r_OverscanBordersDrawDebugView [0=off/1=show]

name: sys_dll_ai
help: Specifies the DLL to load for the AI system

name: sys_dll_game
help: Specifies the game DLL to load

name: sys_game_folder
help: Specifies the game folder to read all data from. Can be fully pathed for external folders or relative path for folders inside the root.

name: sys_dll_response_system
help: Specifies the DLL to load for the dynamic response system

name: sys_build_folder
help: Optionally specifies external full path to the build folder to read pak files from. Can be a full path to an external folder or a relative path to a folder inside of the local build.

name: sys_initpreloadpacks
help: Specifies the paks for an engine initialization

name: sys_menupreloadpacks
help: Specifies the paks for a main menu loading

name: sys_user_folder
help: Specifies the name of the user folder inside the 'Users/<username>/Saved Games/' folder. Empty string means 'User_APPNAME' in the root folder

name: sys_user_subfolder
help: Specifies the name of the subfolder in sys_user_folder. It is used for savegames and profiles

name: sys_gamertag
help: Gamertag displayed instead of user name

name: sys_game_name
help: Specifies the name to be displayed in the Launcher window title bar

name: sys_telemetry_stream_file
help: Telemetry stream file name

name: sys_telemetry_stream_ip
help: Telemetry stream ip address

name: sys_telemetry_keep_alive
help: Telemetry stream keep-alive time

name: ai_NoUpdate
help: Disables AI system update when 1

name: r_AllowLiveMoCap
help: Offers the LiveCreate MoCap Editor on Editor Startup when 1

name: sys_logallocations
help: Save allocation call stack

name: MemStats
help:
0/x=refresh rate in milliseconds
Use 1000 to switch on and 0 to switch off
Usage: MemStats [0..]

name: sys_rendersplashscreen
help: Render the splash screen during game initialization

name: sys_intromoviesduringinit
help: Render the splash screen video during game initialization

name: sys_deferAudioUpdateOptim
help:
0 - disable optimisation
1 - enable optimisation
Default is 1

name: sys_useSteamCloudForPlatformSaving
help: Use steam cloud for save games and profile on PC (instead of the user folder)

name: sys_filesystemCaseSensitivity
help: 0 = Ignore letter casing mismatches, 1 = Show warning on mismatch, 2 = Show error on mismatch

name: sys_noupdate
help:
Toggles updating of system with sys_script_debugger.
Usage: sys_noupdate [0/1]
Default is 0 (system updates during debug).

name: sys_warnings
help:
Toggles printing system warnings.
Usage: sys_warnings [0/1]
Default is 0 (off).

name: sys_keyboard
help:
Enables keyboard.
Usage: sys_keyboard [0/1]
Default is 1 (on).

name: sv_DedicatedMaxRate
help:
Sets the maximum update rate when running as a dedicated server.
Usage: sv_DedicatedMaxRate [5..500]
Default is 30.

name: sv_DedicatedCPUPercent
help:
Sets the target CPU usage when running as a dedicated server, or disable this feature if it's zero.
Usage: sv_DedicatedCPUPercent [0..100]
Default is 0 (disabled).

name: sv_DedicatedCPUVariance
help:
Sets how much the CPU can vary from sv_DedicateCPU (up or down) without adjusting the framerate.
Usage: sv_DedicatedCPUVariance [5..50]
Default is 10.

name: sv_AISystem
help: Load and use the AI system on the server

name: cl_AISystem
help: Load and use the AI system on the client

name: sys_SSInfo
help:
Show SourceSafe information (Name,Comment,Date) for file errors.Usage: sys_SSInfo [0/1]
Default is 0 (off)

name: e_EntitySuppressionLevel
help:
Defines the level at which entities are spawned.
Entities marked with lower level will not be spawned - 0 means no level.
Usage: e_EntitySuppressionLevel [0-infinity]
Default is 0 (off)

name: profile
help:
Allows CPU profiling
Usage: profile #
Where # sets the profiling to:
	0: Profiling off
	1: Self Time
	2: Hierarchical Time
	3: Extended Self Time
	4: Extended Hierarchical Time
	5: Peaks Time
	6: Subsystem Info
	7: Calls Numbers
	8: Standard Deviation
	9: Memory Allocation
	10: Memory Allocation (Bytes)
	11: Stalls
	-1: Profiling enabled, but not displayed
Default is 0 (off)

name: profile_additionalsub
help:
Enable displaying additional sub-system profiling.
Usage: profile_additionalsub #
Where where # may be:
	0: no additional subsystem information
	1: display additional subsystem information
Default is 0 (off)

name: profile_filter
help:
Profiles a specified subsystem.
Usage: profile_filter subsystem
Where 'subsystem' may be:
Renderer
3DEngine
Animation
AI
Entity
Physics
Sound
System
Game
Editor
Script
Network

name: profile_filter_thread
help:
Profiles a specified thread only.
Usage: profile_filter threadName
Where 'threadName' may be:
Main
Renderer
Streaming
etc...

name: profile_graph
help: Enable drawing of profiling graph.

name: profile_graphScale
help:
Sets the scale of profiling histograms.
Usage: profileGraphScale 100

name: profile_pagefaults
help: Enable drawing of page faults graph.

name: profile_allthreads
help: Enables profiling of non-main threads.

name: profile_network
help: Enables network profiling

name: profile_peak
help: Profiler Peaks Tolerance in Milliseconds

name: profile_peak_display
help: hot to cold time for peak display

name: MemInfo
help:
Display memory information by modules
1=on, 0=off

name: profile_sampler
help: Set to 1 to start sampling profiling

name: profile_sampler_max_samples
help: Number of samples to collect for sampling profiler

name: sys_job_system_filter
help:
Filters a Job.
Usage: sys_job_system_filter name1,name2,..
Where 'name' refers to the exact name of the job, 0 disables it
More than one job can be specified by using a comma separated list

name: sys_job_system_enable
help:
Enable the JobSystem.
Usage: sys_job_system_enable 0/1
0: The Jobsystem is disabled, each job is executed in its invoking thread.
1: The JobSystem is enabled, each job is invoked in one of the worker threads.

name: sys_job_system_profiler
help:
Enable the job system profiler.
Usage: sys_job_system_profiler <value>
0: Disable the profiler
1: Show the full profiler
2: Show only the execution graph
3: Show the full profiler and sort by execution time
-1: Profiling enabled, but not displayed

name: sys_job_system_max_worker
help: Sets the number of threads to use for the job systemDefaults to 4 on consoles and 8 threads an PCSet to 0 to create as many threads as cores are available

name: sys_spec
help: Tells the system cfg spec. (0=custom, 1=low, 2=med, 3=high, 4=very high, 5=XBoxOne, 6=PS4)

name: sys_SimulateTask
help: Simulate a task in System:Update which takes X ms

name: sys_firstlaunch
help: Indicates that the game was run for the first time.

name: sys_main_CPU
help: Specifies the physical CPU index main will run on

name: sys_TaskThread0_CPU
help: Specifies the physical CPU index taskthread0 will run on

name: sys_TaskThread1_CPU
help: Specifies the physical CPU index taskthread1 will run on

name: sys_TaskThread2_CPU
help: Specifies the physical CPU index taskthread2 will run on

name: sys_TaskThread3_CPU
help: Specifies the physical CPU index taskthread3 will run on

name: sys_TaskThread4_CPU
help: Specifies the physical CPU index taskthread4 will run on

name: sys_TaskThread5_CPU
help: Specifies the physical CPU index taskthread5 will run on

name: sys_physics_CPU
help: Specifies the physical CPU index physics will run on

name: sys_min_step
help: Specifies the minimum physics step in a separate thread

name: sys_max_step
help: Specifies the maximum physics step in a separate thread

name: sys_enable_budgetmonitoring
help:
Enables budget monitoring. Use #System.SetBudget( sysMemLimitInMB, videoMemLimitInMB,
frameTimeLimitInMS, soundChannelsPlaying ) or sys_budget_sysmem, sys_budget_videomem
or sys_budget_fps to set budget limits.

name: sys_memory_debug
help: Enables to activate low memory situation is specific places in the code (argument defines which place), 0=off

name: sys_streaming_CPU
help: Specifies the physical CPU file IO thread run on

name: sys_streaming_CPU_worker
help: (unused) Specifies the physical CPU file IO worker thread/s run on

name: sys_streaming_memory_budget
help: Temp memory streaming system can use in KB

name: sys_streaming_max_finalize_per_frame
help: Maximum stream finalizing calls per frame to reduce the CPU impact on main thread (0 to disable)

name: sys_streaming_max_bandwidth
help: Enables capping of max streaming bandwidth in MB/s

name: sys_streaming_debug
help:
Enable streaming debug information
0=off
1=Streaming Stats
2=File IO
3=Request Order
4=Write to Log
5=Stats per extension

name: sys_streaming_requests_grouping_time_period
help: Streaming requests are grouped by request time and then sorted by disk offset

name: sys_streaming_debug_filter
help:
Set streaming debug information filter.
0=all
1=Texture
2=Geometry
3=Terrain
4=Animation
7=Sound
8=Shader

name: sys_streaming_debug_filter_file_name
help: Set streaming debug information filter

name: sys_streaming_debug_filter_min_time
help: Show only slow items.

name: sys_streaming_resetstats
help: Reset all the streaming stats

name: sys_streaming_use_optical_drive_thread
help: Allow usage of an extra optical drive thread for faster streaming from 2 medias

name: sys_localization_folder
help:
Sets the folder where to look for localized data.
This cvar allows for backwards compatibility so localized data under the game folder can still be found.
Usage: sys_localization_folder <folder name>
Default: Localization

name: sys_streaming_in_blocks
help: Streaming of large files happens in blocks

name: sys_float_exceptions
help: Use or not use floating point exceptions.

name: sys_no_jobs_inlining
help: Dont use jobs inline execution.

name: sys_update_profile_time
help: Time to keep updates timings history for.

name: sys_WER
help: Enables Windows Error Reporting

name: sys_dump_type
help:
Specifies type of crash dump to create - see MINIDUMP_TYPE in dbghelp.h for full list of values
0: Do not create a minidump
1: Create a small minidump (stacktrace)
2: Create a medium minidump (+ some variables)
3: Create a full minidump (+ all memory)

name: sys_dump_aux_threads
help: Dumps callstacks of other threads in case of a crash

name: sys_keyboard_break
help: Enables keyboard break handler

name: sys_limit_phys_thread_count
help: Limits p_num_threads to physical CPU count - 1

name: sys_MaxFPS
help:
Limits the frame rate to specified number n (if n>0 and if vsync is disabled).
 0 = on PC if vsync is off auto throttles fps while in menu or game is paused (default)
-1 = off

name: sys_maxTimeStepForMovieSystem
help: Caps the time step for the movie system so that a cut-scene won't be jumped in the case of an extreme stall.

name: sys_force_installtohdd_mode
help: Forces install to HDD mode even when doing DVD emulation

name: sys_preload
help: Preload Game Resources

name: sys_scale3DMouseTranslation
help: Scales translation speed of supported 3DMouse devices.

name: sys_Scale3DMouseYPR
help: Scales rotation speed of supported 3DMouse devices.

name: capture_frames
help: Enables capturing of frames. 0=off, 1=on

name: capture_frames_pause
help: Pauses capturing of frames for given number of frames.

name: capture_folder
help: Specifies sub folder to write captured frames.

name: capture_file_format
help: Specifies file format of captured files (jpg, tga).

name: capture_frame_once
help: Makes capture single frame only

name: capture_file_name
help: If set, specifies the path and name to use for the captured frame

name: capture_file_prefix
help: If set, specifies the prefix to use for the captured frame instead of the default 'Frame'.

name: gpu_particle_physics
help: Enable GPU physics if available (0=off / 1=enabled).

name: sys_ProfileLevelLoading
help:
Output level loading stats into log
0 = Off
1 = Output basic info about loading time per function
2 = Output full statistics including loading time and memory allocations with call stack info

name: sys_ProfileLevelLoadingDump
help: Output level loading dump stats into log

name: sys_AI
help: Enables AI Update

name: sys_physics
help: Enables Physics Update

name: sys_entities
help: Enables Entities Update

name: sys_trackview
help: Enables TrackView Update

name: sys_livecreate
help: Enable/disable LiveCreate. Values: 0-disabled, use Null implementation, 1-fully enabled, 2-disabled (but initialized)

name: g_language
help: Defines which language pak is loaded

name: g_languageAudio
help: Will automatically match g_language setting unless specified otherwise

name: sys_languages
help: String list of available languages

name: sys_languages_audio
help: String list of available audio languages

name: wh_sys_specVersion
help: Script can read this to modify its behavior for E3, Gamescom etc.

name: wh_sys_haste
help: Enable/disable 'haste'

name: sys_display_threads
help: Displays Thread info

name: sys_usePlatformSavingAPI
help: Use the platform APIs for saving and loading (complies with TRCs, but allocates lots of memory)

name: sys_error_debugbreak
help: __debugbreak() if a VALIDATOR_ERROR_DBGBREAK message is hit

name: sys_vr_support
help: Specifies if virtual reality (VR) devices should be enabled.

name: dlc_directory
help: Holds the path to the directory where DLC should be installed to and read from

name: sys_screensaver_allowed
help: Specifies if screen saver is allowed to start up while the game is running.

name: sys_parallel_processing
help:
Toggles advanced parallel processing.
Usage: sys_parallel_processing [0/1]
Default is 1 (on).

name: wh_sys_ipl_mode
help: Mode of Initial PayLoad packs. 0=use both IPL and nonIPL, 1=ignore IPL, 2=ignore nonIPL if IPL exists

name: wh_sys_version
help: Version

name: wh_sys_ForceUserName
help: Empty string means no name is forced. Must be in system.cfg

name: wh_sys_publishing
help: Publishing platform name

name: t_Smoothing
help:
time smoothing
0=off, 1=on

name: t_FixedStep
help:
Game updated with this fixed frame time
0=off, number specifies the frame time in seconds
e.g. 0.033333(30 fps), 0.1(10 fps), 0.01(100 fps)

name: t_MaxStep
help: Game systems clamped to this frame time

name: t_Scale
help: All times scaled by this - for variable slow motion

name: t_GameScale
help: Game time scaled by this - for variable slow motion

name: t_Debug
help: Timer debug: 0 = off, 1 = events, 2 = verbose

name: profile_smooth
help: Profiler exponential smoothing interval (seconds)

name: profile_weighting
help: Profiler smoothing mode: 0 = legacy, 1 = average, 2 = peak weighted, 3 = peak hold

name: t_PauseUntilReady
help: When enabled, pauses time until graphics is ready. Useful for capturing frames for Render Output.

name: p_climbable_offset
help:
Maximal climbable offset in z on non-climbable slopes.
Usage: p_climbable_offset 0.25

name: p_sliding_time_mult
help: Higher values will make sliding reach top speed faster (also depends on the slope)

name: p_fly_mode
help:
Toggles fly mode.
Usage: p_fly_mode [0/1]

name: p_collision_mode
help: This variable is obsolete.

name: p_single_step_mode
help:
Toggles physics system 'single step' mode.Usage: p_single_step_mode [0/1]
Default is 0 (off). Set to 1 to switch physics system (except
players) to single step mode. Each step must be explicitly
requested with a 'p_do_step' instruction.

name: p_do_step
help:
Steps physics system forward when in single step mode.
Usage: p_do_step 1
Default is 0 (off). Each 'p_do_step 1' instruction allows
the physics system to advance a single step.

name: p_fixed_timestep
help:
Toggles fixed time step mode.Usage: p_fixed_timestep [0/1]
Forces fixed time step when set to 1. When set to 0, the
time step is variable, based on the frame rate.

name: p_draw_helpers_num
help:
Toggles display of various physical helpers. The value is a bitmask:
bit 0  - show contact points
bit 1  - show physical geometry
bit 8  - show helpers for static objects
bit 9  - show helpers for sleeping physicalized objects (rigid bodies, ragdolls)
bit 10 - show helpers for active physicalized objects
bit 11 - show helpers for players
bit 12 - show helpers for independent entities (alive physical skeletons,particles,ropes)
bits 16-31 - level of bounding volume trees to display (if 0, it just shows geometry)
Examples: show static objects - 258, show active rigid bodies - 1026, show players - 2050

name: p_check_out_of_bounds
help:
Check for physics entities outside world (terrain) grid:
1 - Enable raycasts; 2 - Enable proximity checks; 3 - Both

name: p_max_contact_gap
help:
Sets the gap, enforced whenever possible, between
contacting physical objects.Usage: p_max_contact_gap 0.01
This variable is used for internal tweaking only.

name: p_max_contact_gap_player
help:
Sets the safe contact gap for player collisions with
the physical environment.Usage: p_max_contact_gap_player 0.01
This variable is used for internal tweaking only.

name: p_max_substeps
help:
Limits the number of substeps allowed in variable time step mode.
Usage: p_max_substeps 5
Objects that are not allowed to perform time steps
beyond some value make several substeps.

name: p_prohibit_unprojection

name: p_draw_helpers

Same as p_draw_helpers_num, but encoded in letters
Usage [Entity_Types]_[Helper_Types] - [t|s|r|R|l|i|g|a|y|e]_[g|c|b|l|t(#)]
Entity Types:
t - show terrain
s - show static entities
r - show sleeping rigid bodies
R - show active rigid bodies
l - show living entities
i - show independent entities
g - show triggers
a - show areas
y - show rays in RayWorldIntersection
e - show explosion occlusion maps
Helper Types
g - show geometry
c - show contact points
b - show bounding boxes
l - show tetrahedra lattices for breakable objects
j - show structural joints (will force translucency on the main geometry)
t(#) - show bounding volume trees up to the level #
f(#) - only show geometries with this bit flag set (multiple f's stack)
Example: p_draw_helpers larRis_g - show geometry for static, sleeping, active, independent entities and areas

name: e_svoTI_Active
help: Activates voxel GI for the level

name: e_svoTI_IntegrationMode
help:
GI computations may be used in several ways:
0 = AO + Sun bounce
      Large scale ambient occlusion (static) modulates (or replaces) default ambient lighting
      Single light bounce (fully real-time) is supported for sun and projectors (use '_TI_DYN' in light name)
      This mode takes less memory (only opacity is voxelized) and works acceptable on consoles
1 = Diffuse GI mode (experimental)
      GI completely replaces default diffuse ambient lighting
      Two indirect light bounces are supported for sun and semi-static lights (use '_TI' in light name)
      Single fully dynamic light bounce is supported for projectors (use '_TI_DYN' in light name)
      Default ambient specular is modulated by intensity of diffuse GI
2 = Full GI mode (very experimental)
      Both ambient diffuse and ambient specular lighting is computed by voxel cone tracing
      This mode works fine only on good modern PC

name: e_svoTI_InjectionMultiplier
help: Modulates light injection (controls the intensity of bounce light)

name: e_svoTI_SkyColorMultiplier
help:
Controls amount of the sky light
This value may be multiplied with TOD fog color

name: e_svoTI_UseTODSkyColor
help:
if non 0 - modulate sky light with TOD fog color (top)
Values between 0 and 1 controls the color saturation

name: e_svoTI_PortalsDeform
help:
Adjusts the sky light tracing kernel so that more rays are cast in direction of portals
This helps getting more detailed sky light indoor but may cause distortion of all other indirect lighting

name: e_svoTI_PortalsInject
help:
Inject portal lighting into SVO
This helps getting better indoor sky light even with single bounce

name: e_svoTI_DiffuseAmplifier
help: Adjusts the output brightness of cone traced indirect diffuse component

name: e_svoTI_NumberOfBounces
help:
Maximum number of indirect bounces (from 0 to 2)
First indirect bounce is completely dynamic
The rest of the bounces are cached in SVO and mostly static

name: e_svoTI_Saturation
help: Controls color saturation of propagated light

name: e_svoTI_PropagationBooster
help:
Controls fading of the light during in-SVO propagation
Values greater than 1 help propagating light further but may bring more light leaking artifacts

name: e_svoTI_DiffuseBias
help:
Constant ambient value added to GI
Helps preventing completely black areas
If negative - modulate ambient with near range AO (prevents constant ambient in completely occluded indoor areas)

name: e_svoTI_DiffuseBiasToDOffset
help: Offsets diffuse bias by ToD weather specific values.

name: e_svoTI_DiffuseConeWidth
help:
Controls wideness of diffuse cones
Wider cones work faster but may cause over-occlusion and more light leaking
Narrow cones are slower and may bring more noise

name: e_svoTI_ConeMaxLength
help:
Maximum length of the tracing rays (in meters)
Shorter rays work faster

name: e_svoTI_SpecularAmplifier
help: Adjusts the output brightness of specular component

name: e_svoTI_UpdateLighting
help:
When switched from OFF to ON - forces single full update of cached lighting
If stays enabled - automatically updates lighting if some light source was modified

name: e_svoTI_UpdateGeometry
help:
When switched from OFF to ON - forces single complete re-voxelization of the scene
This is needed if terrain, brushes or vegetation were modified

name: e_svoTI_UpdateGeometryAsync
help:
When switched ON - forces single complete re-voxelization of the scene asynchronously, then automatically switches itself OFF
This is needed if terrain, brushes or vegetation were modified

name: e_svoMinNodeSize
help:
Smallest SVO node allowed to create during level voxelization
Smaller values helps getting more detailed lighting but may work slower and use more memory in pool
It may be necessary to increase VoxelPoolResolution in order to prevent running out of voxel pool

name: e_svoTI_SkipNonGILights
help:
Disable all lights except sun and lights marked to be used for GI
This mode ignores all local environment probes and ambient lights

name: e_svoTI_LowSpecMode
help:
Set low spec mode
Values greater than 0 scale down internal render targets and simplify shaders
If set to -2 it will be initialized by value specified in sys_spec_Shading.cfg (on level load or on spec change)

name: e_svoTI_HalfresKernel
help:
Use less rays for secondary bounce for faster update
Difference is only visible with number of bounces more than 1

name: e_svoTI_UseLightProbes
help:
If enabled - environment probes lighting is multiplied with GI
If disabled - diffuse contribution of environment probes is replaced with GI
In modes 1-2 it enables usage of global env probe for sky light instead of TOD fog color

name: e_svoTI_VoxelizaionLODRatio
help:
Controls distance LOD ratio for voxelization
Bigger value helps getting more detailed lighting at distance but may work slower and will use more memory in pool
It may be necessary to increase VoxelPoolResolution parameter in order to prevent running out of voxel pool

name: e_svoVoxelPoolResolution

Size of volume textures (x,y,z dimensions) used for SVO data storage
Valid values are 128 and 256
Engine has to be restarted if this value was modified
Too big pool size may cause long stalls when some GI parameter was changed

name: e_svoTI_SSAOAmount

name: e_svoTI_ObjectsMaxViewDistance

If set to 0 - disable this check and also disable skipping of too small triangles
Changes are visible after full re-voxelization (click <Update geometry> or restart)

name: e_svoTI_SunRSMInject

name: e_svoTI_SSDepthTrace

name: e_svoStreamVoxels

Enable steaming of voxel data from disk instead of run-time voxelization
Steaming used only in launcher, in the editor voxels are always run-time generated
If enabled, level export will include voxels pre-computation process which may take up to one hour for big complex levels

e.g. 3 will play: looking ahead, 120deg left, 120deg right
default/min: 1

name: wh_autoDemo
help: WH[JM]: Cvar for automated profiling. If set to 1, automatically starts time demo without user interaction after the game starts (from the main menu).

name: wh_demo_variableTime
help: WH[VP]: Used for profiling with budgets. Demo is time driven and demo_fixed_timestep is ignored.

name: wh_demo_profile_peak
help: WH[VP]: Crytek use 50 as default peak value.

name: wh_demo_skipLogInfo
help: WH[VP]: We don't want use LogInfo because it write to file on main thread.

name: m_wh_demo_positionOverride
help: Override player position by this value during timeDemo.

name: v_lights
help:
Controls vehicle lights.
0: disable all lights
1: enable lights only for local player
2: enable all lights

name: v_lights_enable_always
help: Vehicle lights are always on (debugging)

name: v_autoDisable
help: Enables/disables vehicle autodisabling

name: v_set_passenger_tm
help: enable/disable passenger entity tm update

name: v_disable_hull
help: Disable hull proxies

name: v_staticTreadDeform
help: enables physics-based deforming of threads even for *non-moving* vehicles

name: v_transitionAnimations
help: Enables enter/exit transition animations for vehicles

name: v_playerTransitions
help: Enables enter/exit transition animations for vehicles

name: v_ragdollPassengers
help: Forces vehicle passenger to detach and ragdoll when they die inside of a vehicle

name: v_goliathMode
help: Makes all vehicles invincible

name: v_enableMannequin
help: Enables enter/exit transition animations for vehicles

name: v_serverControlled
help: Makes the vehicles server authoritative, clients only send inputs to the server who then drives the vehicles

name: v_clientPredict
help: Enable client-side prediction on vehicle movement

name: v_clientPredictSmoothing
help: Enable client-side prediction smoothing on vehicle movement

name: v_testClientPredict
help: Test client-side prediction on a listen server with no clients, the value represents the number of frames to rewind and replay

name: v_clientPredictSmoothingConst
help: The amount of smoothing to use, lower values result in smoothing looking movement but more lag behind the true position

name: v_clientPredictAdditionalTime
help: Additional time offset to calibrate client prediction, will be added to ping and p_net_interp cvar

name: v_clientPredictMaxTime
help: The maximum time the client can predict ahead of the server position (should be roughly equal to the maximum ping we expect in the real world)

name: v_slipSlopeFront
help: coefficient for slip friction slope calculation (front wheels)

name: v_slipSlopeRear
help: coefficient for slip friction slope calculation (rear wheels)

name: v_slipFrictionModFront
help: if non-zero, used as slip friction modifier (front wheels)

name: v_slipFrictionModRear
help: if non-zero, used as slip friction modifier (rear wheels)

name: v_FlippedExplosionTimeToExplode
help: The number of seconds to wait after a vehicle is flipped to attempt exploding

name: v_FlippedExplosionPlayerMinDistance
help: If a player is within this distance then don't explode yet

name: v_FlippedExplosionRetryTimeMS
help: If a nearby player blocked explosion then try again after this time period

name: v_disableEntry
help: Don't allow players to enter vehicles

name: v_vehicle_quality
help: Geometry/Physics quality (1-lowspec, 4-highspec)

name: v_driverControlledMountedGuns
help: Specifies if the driver can control the vehicles mounted gun when driving without gunner.

name: v_independentMountedGuns
help: Whether mounted gunners operate their turret independently from the parent vehicle

name: v_debugSuspensionIK
help: Debug draw the suspension ik

name: cl_camera_noise
help:
Adds hand-held like camera noise to the camera view. 
 The higher the value, the higher the noise.
 A value <= 0 disables it.

name: cl_camera_noise_freq
help:
Defines camera noise frequency for the camera view. 
 The higher the value, the higher the noise.

name: cl_ViewSystemDebug
help: Sets Debug information of the ViewSystem.

name: cl_DefaultNearPlane
help: The default camera near plane.

name: cl_visualLog
help: Enables Visual Logging.

name: cl_visualLogFolder
help: Specifies sub folder to write logs to.

name: cl_visualLogImageFormat
help: Specifies file format of captured files (jpg, bmp).

name: cl_visualLogImageScale
help: Image size. [0-1] = scale value. >1 = actual pixels for image width

name: ai_CompatibilityMode
help: Set AI features to behave in earlier milestones - please use sparingly

name: ai_DebugDrawAStarOpenList
help:
Draws the A* open list for the specified AI agent.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawAStarOpenList [AI agent name]
Default is 0, which disables the debug draw. Requires ai_DebugPathfinding=1 to be activated.

name: ai_DebugCheckWalkabilityRadius
help: Radius to use for the per-frame debug CheckWalkability test.

name: ai_DebugDrawAStarOpenListTime
help: The amount of time to draw the A* open list.

name: ai_DrawNode
help:
Toggles visibility of named agent's position on AI triangulation.
See also: ai_DrawNodeLinkType and ai_DrawNodeLinkCutoff
Usage: ai_DrawNode [ai agent's name]
 none - switch off
 all - to display nodes of all the AI agents
 player - to display player's node
 AI agent's name - to display node of particular agent

name: ai_Locate
help:
Indicates position and some base states of specified objects.
It will pinpoint position of the agents; it's name; it's attention target;
draw red cone if the agent is allowed to fire; draw purple cone if agent is pressing trigger.
 none - off
 squad - squadmates
 enemy - all the enemies
 groupID - members of specified group

name: ai_DrawPath
help:
Draws the generated paths of the AI agents. ai_drawoffset is used.
Usage: ai_DrawPath [name]
 none - off (default)
 squad - squadmates
 enemy - all the enemies

name: ai_DrawPathAdjustment
help:
Draws the path adjustment for the AI agents.
Usage: ai_DrawPathAdjustment [name]
Default is none (nobody).

name: ai_DrawRefPoints
help:
Toggles reference points and beacon view for debugging AI.
Usage: ai_DrawRefPoints "all", agent name, group id 
Default is the empty string (off). Indicates the AI reference points by drawing
balls at their positions.

name: ai_StatsTarget
help:
Focus debugging information on a specific AI
Display current goal pipe, current goal, subpipes and agentstats information for the selected AI agent.
Long green line will represent the AI forward direction (game forward).
Long red/blue (if AI firing on/off) line will represent the AI view direction.
Usage: ai_StatsTarget AIName
Default is 'none'. AIName is the name of the AI
on which to focus.

name: ai_DebugDrawPhysicsAccess
help: Displays current physics access statistics for the AI module.

name: ai_DebugBehaviorSelection
help:
Display behavior selection information for a specific agent
Usage: ai_DebugBehaviorSelection <name>

name: ai_RayCasterQuota
help: Amount of deferred rays allowed to be cast per frame!

name: ai_IntersectionTesterQuota
help: Amount of deferred intersection tests allowed to be cast per frame!

name: ai_DebugHideSpotName
help: Debug HideSpot Name!

name: ai_DrawShooting
help: Name of puppet to show fire stats

name: ai_DrawAgentStats
help:
Flag field specifying which of the overhead agent stats to display:
N - name
k - groupID
d - distances
c - cover info
B - currently selected behavior node
b - current behavior
t - target info
G - goal pipe
g - goal op
S - stance
f - fire
w - territory/wave
p - pathfinding status
l - light level (perception) status
D - various direction arrows (aim target, move target, ...) status
L - personal log
a - alertness

Default is NkcBbtGgSfdDL

name: ai_DrawAgentStatsGroupFilter
help:
Filters Debug Draw Agent Stats displays to the specified groupIDs separated by spaces
usage: ai_DrawAgentStatsGroupFilter 1011 1012

name: ai_DrawPerceptionHandlerModifiers
help:
Draws perception handler modifiers on a specific AI
Usage: ai_DrawPerceptionHandlerModifiers AIName
Default is 'none'. AIName is the name of the AI

name: ai_ForceAGAction
help: Forces all AI characters to specified AG action input. 0 to disable.

name: ai_ForceAGSignal
help: Forces all AI characters to specified AG signal input. 0 to disable.

name: ai_ForcePosture
help: Forces all AI characters to specified posture. 0 to disable.

name: ai_ForceLookAimTarget
help:
Forces all AI characters to use/not use a fixed look/aim target
none disables
x, y, xz or yz sets it to the appropriate direction
otherwise it forces looking/aiming at the entity with this name (no name -> (0, 0, 0))

name: ai_CheckWalkabilityOptimalSectionLength
help:
The maximum segment length used by CheckWalkabilityFast when querying for world geometry from physics.
Default: 1.75

name: ai_TacticalPointUpdateTime
help:
Maximum allowed update time in main AI thread for Tactical Point System
Usage: ai_TacticalPointUpdateTime <number>
Default is 0.0003

name: ai_UpdateAllAlways
help: If non-zero then over-rides the auto-disabling of invisible/distant AI

name: ai_UseCalculationStopperCounter
help: Uses a (calibrated) counter instead of time in AI updates

name: ai_UpdateInterval
help:
In seconds the amount of time between two full updates for AI  
Usage: ai_UpdateInterval <number>
Default is 0.1. Number is time in seconds

name: ai_DynamicWaypointUpdateTime
help:
How long (max) to spend updating dynamic waypoint regions per AI update (in sec)
0 disables dynamic updates. 0.0005 is a sensible value

name: ai_DynamicVolumeUpdateTime
help:
How long (max) to spend updating dynamic volume regions per AI update (in sec)
0 disables dynamic updates. 0.002 is a sensible value

name: ai_LayerSwitchDynamicLinkBump
help: Multiplier for the dynamic link update budget when layer switch occurs.

name: ai_LayerSwitchDynamicLinkBumpDuration
help: Duration of the dynamic link update budget bump in frames.

name: ai_AdjustPathsAroundDynamicObstacles
help: Set to 1/0 to enable/disable AI path adjustment around dynamic obstacles

name: ai_EnableORCA
help: Enable obstacle avoidance system.

name: ai_CollisionAvoidanceUpdateVelocities
help: Enable/disable agents updating their velocities after processing collision avoidance.

name: ai_CollisionAvoidanceEnableRadiusIncrement
help: Enable/disable agents adding an increment to their collision avoidance radius when moving.

name: ai_CollisionAvoidanceClampVelocitiesWithNavigationMesh
help:
Enable/Disable the clamping of the speed resulting from ORCA with the navigation mesh
		2 - means disabling avoidance for agents that are not on nav mesh

name: ai_DebugDrawCollisionAvoidance
help: Enable debugging obstacle avoidance system.

name: ai_BubblesSystem
help: Enables/disables bubble notifier.

name: ai_BubblesSystemDecayTime
help: Specifies the decay time for the bubbles drawn on screen.

name: ai_BubblesSystemAlertnessFilter
help:
Specifies the type of messages you want to receive:
0 - none
1 - Only logs in the console
2 - Only bubbles
3 - Logs and bubbles
4 - Only blocking popups
5 - Blocking popups and logs
6 - Blocking popups and bubbles
7 - All notifications

name: ai_BubblesSystemUseDepthTest
help: Specifies if the BubblesSystem should use the depth test to show the messages inside the 3D world.

name: ai_BubbleSystemAllowPrototypeDialogBubbles
help: Enabling the visualization of the bubbles created to prototype AI dialogs

name: ai_BubblesSystemFontSize
help: Font size for the BubblesSystem.

name: ai_PathfinderDangerCostForAttentionTarget
help: Cost used in the heuristic calculation for the danger created by the attention target position.

name: ai_PathfinderDangerCostForExplosives
help: Cost used in the heuristic calculation for the danger created by the position of explosive objects.

name: ai_PathfinderAvoidanceCostForGroupMates
help: Cost used in the heuristic calculation for the avoidance of the group mates's positions.

name: ai_PathfinderExplosiveDangerRadius
help: Range used to evaluate the explosive threats in the path calculation. Outside this range a location is considered safe.

name: ai_PathfinderExplosiveDangerMaxThreatDistance
help: Range used to decide if evaluate an explosive danger as an actual threat.

name: ai_PathfinderGroupMatesAvoidanceRadius
help: Range used to evaluate the group mates avoidance in the path calculation.

name: ai_DebugMovementSystem
help: Draw debug information to the screen regarding character movement.

name: ai_DebugMovementSystemActorRequests
help:
Draw queued movement requests of actors in the world as text above their head.
0 - Off
1 - Draw request queue of only the currently selected agent
2 - Draw request queue of all agents

name: ai_OutputPersonalLogToConsole
help: Output the personal log messages to the console.

name: ai_DrawModularBehaviorTreeStatistics
help: Draw modular behavior statistics to the screen.

name: ai_MNMPathfinderPositionInTrianglePredictionType
help:
Defines which type of prediction for the point inside each triangle used by the pathfinder heuristic to search for the path with minimal cost.
0 - Triangle center.
1 - Advanced prediction.

name: ai_MovementSystemPathReplanningEnabled
help:
Enable/disable path-replanning of moving actors in the MovementSystem every time
a navigation-mesh change at runtime affects their current path.
Ignores designer-placed paths.
0 - disabled (default)
1 - enabled

name: ai_CollisionAvoidanceRange
help: Range for collision avoidance.

name: ai_CollisionAvoidanceTargetCutoffRange
help: Distance from it's current target for an agent to stop avoiding obstacles. Other actors will still avoid the agent.

name: ai_CollisionAvoidancePathEndCutoffRange
help: Distance from it's current path end for an agent to stop avoiding obstacles. Other actors will still avoid the agent.

name: ai_CollisionAvoidanceSmartObjectCutoffRange
help: Distance from it's next smart object for an agent to stop avoiding obstacles. Other actors will still avoid the agent.

name: ai_CollisionAvoidanceAgentExtraFat
help: Extra radius to use in Collision Avoidance calculations as a buffer.

name: ai_CollisionAvoidanceRadiusIncrementIncreaseRate
help: Increase rate of the collision avoidance radius increment.

name: ai_CollisionAvoidanceRadiusIncrementDecreaseRate
help: Decrease rate of the collision avoidance radius increment.

name: ai_CollisionAvoidanceTimestep
help: TimeStep used to calculate an agent's collision free velocity.

name: ai_CollisionAvoidanceMinSpeed
help: Minimum speed allowed to be used by ORCA.

name: ai_CollisionAvoidanceAgentTimeHorizon
help: Time horizon used to calculate an agent's collision free velocity against other agents.

name: ai_CollisionAvoidanceObstacleTimeHorizon
help: Time horizon used to calculate an agent's collision free velocity against static obstacles.

name: ai_DebugCollisionAvoidanceForceSpeed
help: Force agents velocity to it's current direction times the specified value.

name: ai_DebugDrawCollisionAvoidanceAgentName
help: Name of the agent to draw collision avoidance data for.

name: ai_SOMSpeedRelaxed
help:
Time before the AI will see the enemy while relaxed.
Usage: ai_SOMSpeedRelaxed 0.4
Default is 0.4. A lower value causes the AI to react to the enemy faster.

name: ai_SOMSpeedCombat
help:
Time before the AI will see the enemy while alarmed.
Usage: ai_SOMSpeedCombat 0.15
Default is 0.15. A lower value causes the AI to react to the enemy faster.

name: ai_SightRangeSuperDarkIllumMod
help: Multiplier for sightrange when the target is in super dark light condition.

name: ai_SightRangeDarkIllumMod
help: Multiplier for sightrange when the target is in dark light condition.

name: ai_SightRangeMediumIllumMod
help: Multiplier for sightrange when the target is in medium light condition.

name: ai_PathfindTimeLimit
help:
Specifies how many seconds an individual AI can hold the pathfinder blocked
Usage: ai_PathfindTimeLimit 0.15
Default is 0.08. A lower value will result in more path requests that end in NOPATH -
although the path may actually exist.

name: ai_PathfinderUpdateTime
help: Maximum pathfinder time per AI update

name: ai_DrawAgentFOV
help:
Toggles the vision cone of the AI agent.
Usage: ai_DrawagentFOV [0..1]
Default is 0 (off), value 1 will draw the cone all the way to
the sight range, value 0.1 will draw the cone to distance of 10%
of the sight range, etc. ai_DebugDraw must be enabled before
this tool can be used.

name: ai_FilterAgentName
help:
Only draws the AI info of the agent with the given name.
Usage: ai_FilterAgentName name
Default is none (draws all of them if ai_debugdraw is on)

name: ai_AgentStatsDist
ai_DebugDrawArrowLabelsVisibilityDistance
help:
Provided ai_DebugDraw > 0, if the camera is closer to an agent than this distance,
agent arrows for look/fire/move arrows will have labels.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawArrowLabelsVisibilityDistance [distance]
Default is 50.

name: ai_DebugDraw
help:
Toggles the AI debugging view.
Usage: ai_DebugDraw [-1/0/1]
Default is 0 (minimal), value -1 will draw nothing, value 1 displays AI rays and targets 
and enables the view for other AI debugging tools.

name: ai_NetworkDebug
help:
Toggles the AI network debug.
Usage: ai_NetworkDebug [0/1]
Default is 0 (off). ai_NetworkDebug is used to direct DebugDraw information 
from the server to the client.

name: ai_DebugDrawHideSpotSearchRays
help:
Toggle drawing rays used in HM_ONLY_IF_CAN_SHOOT_FROM_THERE hide spot search option.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawHideSpotSearchRays [0..1]

name: ai_DebugDrawVegetationCollisionDist
help: Enables drawing vegetation collision closer than a distance projected onto the terrain.

name: ai_DebugDrawHidespotRange
help: Sets the range for drawing hidespots around the player (needs ai_DebugDraw > 0).

name: ai_DebugDrawDynamicHideObjectsRange
help: Sets the range for drawing dynamic hide objects around the player (needs ai_DebugDraw > 0).

name: ai_DebugDrawVolumeVoxels
help:
Toggles the AI debugging drawing of voxels in volume generation.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawVolumeVoxels [0, 1, 2 etc]
Default is 0 (off)
+n draws all voxels with original value >= n
-n draws all voxels with original value =  n

name: ai_DebugPathfinding
help: Toggles output of pathfinding information [default 0 is off]

name: ai_DebugCheckWalkability
help: Toggles output of check walkability information, as well as allowing the use of tagpoints named CheckWalkabilityTestStart/End to trigger a test each update. [default 0 is off]

name: ai_DebugWalkabilityCache
help: Toggles allowing the use of tagpoints named WalkabilityCacheOrigin to cache walkability. [default 0 is off]

name: ai_DebugDrawBannedNavsos
help: Toggles drawing banned navsos [default 0 is off]

name: ai_DebugDrawGroups
help:
Toggles the AI Groups debugging view.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawGroups [0/1]
Default is 0 (off). ai_DebugDrawGroups displays groups' leaders, members and their desired positions.

name: ai_DebugDrawCoolMisses
help:
Toggles displaying the cool miss locations around the player.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawCoolMisses [0/1]

name: ai_DebugDrawFireCommand
help:
Toggles displaying the fire command targets and modifications.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawFireCommand [0/1]

name: ai_UseSimplePathfindingHeuristic
help:
Toggles the AI using a straight simple distance heuristic for debugging.
Usage: ai_UseSimpleHeuristic [0/1]

name: ai_CoverSystem
help:
Enables the cover system.
Usage: ai_CoverSystem [0/1]
Default is 1 (on)
0 - off - use anchors
1 - use offline cover surfaces

name: ai_CoverPredictTarget
help:
Enables simple cover system target location prediction.
Usage: ai_CoverPredictTarget x
Default x is 0.0 (off)
x - how many seconds to look ahead

name: ai_CoverSpacing
help:
Minimum spacing between agents when choosing cover.
Usage: ai_CoverPredictTarget <x>
x - Spacing width in meters

name: ai_CoverExactPositioning
help:
Enables using exact positioning for arriving at cover.
Usage: ai_CoverPredictTarget [0/1]
Default x is 0 (off)
0 - disable
1 - enable

name: ai_CoverMaxEyeCount
help:
Max numbers of observers to consider when selecting cover.
Usage: ai_CoverMaxEyeCount <x>

name: ai_DebugDrawCover
help:
Displays cover debug information.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawCover [0/1/2]
Default is 0 (off)
0 - off
1 - currently being used
2 - all in 50m range (slow)

name: ai_DebugDrawCoverOccupancy
help:
Renders red balls at the location of occupied cover.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawCoverOccupancy [0/1]
Default is 0 (off)
0 - off
1 - render red balls at the location of occupied cover

name: ai_DebugDrawNavigation
help:
Displays the navigation debug information.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawNavigation [0/1]
Default is 0 (off)
0 - off
1 - triangles and contour
2 - triangles, mesh and contours
3 - triangles, mesh contours and external links
4 - triangles, mesh contours, external links and triangle IDs
5 - triangles, mesh contours, external links and island IDs

name: ai_IslandConnectionsSystemProfileMemory
help: Enables/Disables the memory profile for the island connections system.

name: ai_NavigationSystemMT
help:
Enables navigation information updates on a separate thread.
Usage: ai_NavigationSystemMT [0/1]
Default is 1 (on)
0 - off
1 - on

name: ai_NavGenThreadJobs
help:
Number of tile generation jobs per thread per frame.
Usage: ai_NavGenThreadJobs [1+]
Default is 1. The more you have, the faster it will go but the frame rate will drop while it works.
Recommendations:
 Fast machine [10]
 Slow machine [4]
 Smooth [1]

name: ai_DebugDrawNavigationWorldMonitor
help:
Enables displaying bounding boxes for world changes.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawNavigationWorldMonitor [0/1]
Default is 0 (off)
0 - off
1 - on

name: ai_DebugDrawCoverPlanes
help:
Displays cover planes.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawCoverPlanes [0/1]
Default is 0 (off)

name: ai_DebugDrawCoverLocations
help:
Displays cover locations.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawCoverLocations [0/1]
Default is 0 (off)

name: ai_DebugDrawCoverSampler
help:
Displays cover sampler debug rendering.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawCoverSampler [0/1/2/3]
Default is 0 (off)
0 - off
1 - display floor sampling
2 - display surface sampling
3 - display both

name: ai_DebugDrawDynamicCoverSampler
help:
Displays dynamic cover sampler debug rendering.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawDynamicCoverSampler [0/1]
Default is 0 (off)
0 - off
1 - on

name: ai_DebugDrawCommunication
help:
Displays communication debug information.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawCommunication [0/1/2]
 0 - disabled. (default).
 1 - draw playing and queued comms.
 2 - draw debug history for each entity.
 5 - extended debugging (to log) 6 - outputs info about each line played

name: ai_DebugDrawCommunicationHistoryDepth
help:
Tweaks how many historical entries are displayed per entity.
Usage: ai_DebugDrawCommunicationHistoryDepth [depth]

name: ai_RecordCommunicationStats
help:
Turns on/off recording of communication stats to a log.
Usage: ai_RecordCommunicationStats [0/1]

name: ai_CommunicationManagerHeighThresholdForTargetPosition
help: Defines the threshold used to detect if the target is above or below the entity that wants to play a communication.

name: ai_CommunicationForceTestVoicePack
help: Forces all the AI agents to use a test voice pack. The test voice pack will have the specified name in the archetype or in the entity and the system will replace the _XX number with the _test string

name: ai_DrawNodeLinkType
help:
Sets the link parameter to draw with ai_DrawNode.
Values are:
 0 - pass radius (default)
 1 - exposure
 2 - water max depth
 3 - water min depth

name: ai_DrawNodeLinkCutoff
help:
Sets the link cutoff value in ai_DrawNodeLinkType. If the link value is more than
ai_DrawNodeLinkCutoff the number gets displayed in green, otherwise red.

name: ai_SystemUpdate
help:
Toggles the regular AI system update.
Usage: ai_SystemUpdate [0/1]
Default is 1 (on). Set to 0 to disable ai system updating.

name: ai_SoundPerception
help:
Toggles AI sound perception.
Usage: ai_SoundPerception [0/1]
Default is 1 (on). Used to prevent AI from hearing sounds for
debugging purposes. Works with ai_DebugDraw enabled.

name: ai_IgnorePlayer
help:
Makes AI ignore the player.
Usage: ai_IgnorePlayer [0/1]
Default is 0 (off). Set to 1 to make AI ignore the player.
Used with ai_DebugDraw enabled.

name: ai_IgnoreVisibilityChecks
help: Makes certain visibility checks (for teleporting etc) return false.

name: ai_DrawFormations
help:
Draws all the currently active formations of the AI agents.
Usage: ai_DrawFormations [0/1]
Default is 0 (off). Set to 1 to draw the AI formations.

name: ai_DrawSmartObjects
help:
Draws smart object debug information.
Usage: ai_DrawSmartObjects [0/1]
Default is 0 (off). Set to 1 to draw the smart objects.

name: ai_DrawReadibilities
help:
Draws all the currently active readibilities of the AI agents.
Usage: ai_DrawReadibilities [0/1]
Default is 0 (off). Set to 1 to draw the AI readibilities.

name: ai_DrawGoals
help:
Draws all the active goal ops debug info.
Usage: ai_DrawGoals [0/1]
Default is 0 (off). Set to 1 to draw the AI goal op debug info.

name: ai_AllTime
help:
Displays the update times of all agents, in milliseconds.
Usage: ai_AllTime [0/1]
Default is 0 (off). Times all agents and displays the time used updating
each of them. The name is colour coded to represent the update time.
	Green: less than 1 ms (ok)
	White: 1 ms to 5 ms
	Red: more than 5 ms
You must enable ai_DebugDraw before you can use this tool.

name: ai_ProfileGoals
help:
Toggles timing of AI goal execution.
Usage: ai_ProfileGoals [0/1]
Default is 0 (off). Records the time used for each AI goal (like
approach, run or pathfind) to execute. The longest execution time
is displayed on screen. Used with ai_DebugDraw enabled.

name: ai_BeautifyPath
help:
Toggles AI optimisation of the generated path.
Usage: ai_BeautifyPath [0/1]
Default is 1 (on). Optimisation is on by default. Set to 0 to
disable path optimisation (AI uses non-optimised path).

name: ai_PathStringPullingIterations
help: Defines the number of iteration used for the string pulling operation to simplify the path

name: ai_AttemptStraightPath
help:
Toggles AI attempting a simple straight path when possible.
Default is 1 (on).

name: ai_CrowdControlInPathfind
help:
Toggles AI using crowd control in pathfinding.
Usage: ai_CrowdControlInPathfind [0/1]
Default is 0 (off).

name: ai_DebugDrawCrowdControl
help: Draws crowd control debug information. 0=off, 1=on

name: ai_PredictivePathFollowing
help: Sets if AI should use the predictive path following if allowed by the type's config.

name: ai_SteepSlopeUpValue
help:
Indicates slope value that is borderline-walkable up.
Usage: ai_SteepSlopeUpValue 0.5
Default is 1.0 Zero means flat. Infinity means vertical. Set it smaller than ai_SteepSlopeAcrossValue

name: ai_SteepSlopeAcrossValue
help:
Indicates slope value that is borderline-walkable across.
Usage: ai_SteepSlopeAcrossValue 0.8
Default is 0.6 Zero means flat. Infinity means vertical. Set it greater than ai_SteepSlopeUpValue

name: ai_UpdateProxy
help:
Toggles update of AI proxy (model).
Usage: ai_UpdateProxy [0/1]
Default is 1 (on). Updates proxy (AI representation in game)
set to 0 to disable proxy updating.

name: ai_DrawType
help:
Display all AI object of specified type. If object is enabled it will be displayed.
with blue ball, otherwise with red ball. Yellow line will represent forward direction of the object.
 <0 - off
 0 - display all the dummy objects
 >0 - type of AI objects to display

name: ai_DrawModifiers
help: Toggles the AI debugging view of navigation modifiers.

name: ai_DrawOffset
help: vertical offset during debug drawing (graph nodes, navigation paths, ...)

name: ai_DrawTargets

Distance to path end threshold for path follower results smoother. If AI is closer to the end than this threshold

r_MSAA_quality and r_MSAA_samples.

1 disable sample frequency pass
