name: r_ShowBufferUsage
help:
Shows usage of statically allocated buffers.
Usage: r_ShowBufferUSage [0/1]
Default is 0 (off).

name: r_LogVBuffers
help:
Logs vertex buffers in memory to 'LogVBuffers.txt'.
Usage: r_LogVBuffers [0/1]
Default is 0 (off).

name: r_LogTexStreaming
help:
Logs streaming info to Direct3DLogStreaming.txt
0: off
1: normal
2: extended

name: r_LogShaders
help:
Logs shaders info to Direct3DLogShaders.txt
0: off
1: normal
2: extended

name: r_minimizeLatency
help:
Initializes and drives renderer to minimize display latency as much as possible.
As such only a double buffer swap chain will be created.
Maximum frame latency will be set to 1 on DXGI-supporting platforms
as well as frames flushed after Present() if r_Flush is enabled.

name: r_ShadersDebug
help:
Enable special logging when shaders become compiled
Usage: r_ShadersDebug [0/1/2/3/4]
 1 = assembly into directory Main/{Game}/shaders/cache/d3d9
 2 = compiler input into directory Main/{Game}/testcg
 3 = compiler input with debug information (useful for PIX etc./{Game}/testcg_1pass
 4 = compiler input with debug information, but optimized shaders
Default is 0 (off)

name: r_ShadersRemoteCompiler
help: Enables remote shader compilation on dedicated machine

name: r_ShadersAsyncCompiling
help:
Enable asynchronous shader compiling
Usage: r_ShadersAsyncCompiling [0/1/2/3]
 0 = off, (stalling) shaders compiling
 1 = on, shaders are compiled in parallel, missing shaders are rendered in yellow
 2 = on, shaders are compiled in parallel, missing shaders are not rendered
 3 = on, shaders are compiled in parallel in precache mode

name: r_ShadersAsyncActivation
help:
Enable asynchronous shader activation
Usage: r_ShadersAsyncActivation [0/1]
 0 = off, (stalling) synchronous shaders activation
 1 = on, shaders are activated/streamed asynchronously

name: r_ShadersEditing
help: Force all cvars to settings, which allow shader editing

name: r_ShadersCompileAutoActivate
help: Automatically reenable shader compilation if outdated shader is detected

name: r_ArmourPulseSpeedMultiplier
help: Armour pulse speed multiplier - default = 1.0

name: r_MaxSuitPulseSpeedMultiplier
help: Max suit pulse speed multiplier - default = 1.0

name: r_ReflectTextureSlots
help: Reflect texture slot information from shader

name: r_ShadersCacheDeterministic
help: Ensures that 2 shaderCaches built from the same source are binary equal

name: r_ShadersLogCacheMisses
help:
Log all shader caches misses on HD (both level and global shader cache misses).
0 = No logging to disk or TTY
1 = Logging to disk only
2 = Logging to disk and TTY (default)

name: r_ShadersImport
help: 0 off, 1 import and allow fallback to getBinShader, 2 import, no fallback if import fails (optimal).

name: r_ShadersExport
help: 0 off, 1 allow shader export during shader cache generation - Currently 360 only.

name: r_DebugRefraction
help:
Debug refraction usage. Displays red instead of refraction
Usage: r_DebugRefraction
Default is 0 (off)

name: r_MeshPoolSize
help: The size of the pool for render data in kilobytes. Disabled by default on PC (mesh data allocated on heap).Enabled by default on consoles. Requires app restart to change.

name: r_MeshInstancePoolSize
help: The size of the pool for volatile render data in kilobytes. Disabled by default on PC (mesh data allocated on heap).Enabled by default on consoles. Requires app restart to change.

name: r_ExcludeShader
help:
Exclude the named shader from the render list.
Usage: r_ExcludeShader ShaderName
Sometimes this is useful when debugging.

name: r_ExcludeMesh
help:
Exclude or ShowOnly the named mesh from the render list.
Usage: r_ExcludeShader Name
Usage: r_ExcludeShader !Name
Sometimes this is useful when debugging.

name: r_ProfileShaders
help:
Enables display of render profiling information.
Usage: r_ProfileShaders [0/1]
Default is 0 (off). Set to 1 to display profiling
of rendered shaders.

name: r_ProfileShadersSmooth
help:
Smooth time information.
Usage: r_ProfileShadersSmooth [0-10]

name: r_ProfileShadersGroupByName
help:
Group items by name ignoring RT flags.
Usage: r_ProfileShaders [0/1]

name: r_EnvCMResolution
help:
Sets resolution for target environment cubemap, in pixels.
Usage: r_EnvCMResolution #
where # represents:
	0: 64
	1: 128
	2: 256
Default is 2 (256 by 256 pixels).

name: r_EnvTexResolution
help:
Sets resolution for 2d target environment texture, in pixels.
Usage: r_EnvTexResolution #
where # represents:
	0: 64
	1: 128
	2: 256
	3: 512
Default is 3 (512 by 512 pixels).

name: r_WaterUpdateFactor
help:
Distance factor for water reflected texture updating.
Usage: r_WaterUpdateFactor 0.01
Default is 0.01. 0 means update every frame

name: r_EnvCMupdateInterval
help:
Sets the interval between environmental cube map texture updates.
Usage: r_EnvCMupdateInterval #
Default is 0.1.

name: r_EnvTexUpdateInterval
help:
Sets the interval between environmental 2d texture updates.
Usage: r_EnvTexUpdateInterval 0.001
Default is 0.001.

name: r_WaterReflections
help:
Toggles water reflections.
Usage: r_WaterReflections [0/1]
Default is 1 (water reflects).

name: r_WaterReflectionsMGPU
help:
Toggles water reflections.multi-gpu support
Usage: r_WaterReflectionsMGPU [0/1/2]
Default is 0 (single render update), 1 (multiple render updates)

name: r_WaterReflectionsQuality
help:
Activates water reflections quality setting.
Usage: r_WaterReflectionsQuality [0/1/2/3]
Default is 0 (terrain only), 1 (terrain + particles), 2 (terrain + particles + brushes), 3 (everything)

name: r_WaterReflectionsUseMinOffset
help: Activates water reflections use min distance offset.

name: r_WaterReflectionsMinVisiblePixelsUpdate
help: Activates water reflections if visible pixels above a certain threshold.

name: r_WaterReflectionsMinVisUpdateFactorMul
help: Activates update factor multiplier when water mostly occluded.

name: r_WaterReflectionsMinVisUpdateDistanceMul
help: Activates update distance multiplier when water mostly occluded.

name: r_WaterCaustics
help:
Toggles under water caustics.
Usage: r_WaterCaustics [0/1]
Default is 1 (enabled).

name: r_WaterCausticsDistance
help:
Toggles under water caustics max distance.
Usage: r_WaterCausticsDistance
Default is 100.0 meters

name: r_WaterCausticsDeferred
help:
Toggles under water caustics deferred pass.
Usage: r_WaterCausticsDeferred [0/1/2]
Default is 0 (disabled). 1 - enables. 2 - enables with stencil pre-pass

name: r_WaterVolumeCaustics
help:
Toggles advanced water caustics for watervolumes.
Usage: r_WaterVolumeCaustics [0/1]
Default is 0 (disabled). 1 - enables.

name: r_WaterVolumeCausticsDensity
help:
Density/resolution of watervolume caustic grid.
Usage: r_WaterVolumeCausticsDensity [16/256]
Default is 256

name: r_WaterVolumeCausticsRes
help:
Resolution of watervoluem caustics texture.
Usage: r_WaterVolumeCausticsRes [n]
Default is 1024

name: r_WaterVolumeCausticsSnapFactor
help:
Distance in which to snap the vertex grid/projection (to avoid aliasing).
Usage: r_WaterVolumeCausticsSnapFactor [n]
Default is 1.0

name: r_WaterVolumeCausticsMaxDist
help:
Maximum distance in which caustics are visible.
Usage: r_WaterVolumeCausticsMaxDist [n]
Default is 35

name: r_WaterGodRays
help:
Enables under water god rays.
Usage: r_WaterGodRays [0/1]
Default is 1 (enabled).

name: r_WaterGodRaysDistortion
help:
Set the amount of distortion when underwater.
Usage: r_WaterGodRaysDistortion [n]
Default is 1.

name: r_WaterUpdateThread
help:
Enables water updating on separate thread (when MT supported).
Usage: r_WaterUpdateThread [0/1/2/3/4/n]
Default is 5 (enabled and on 5 hw thread).

name: r_Reflections
help:
Toggles reflections.
Usage: r_Reflections [0/1]
Default is 1 (reflects).

name: r_ReflectionsQuality
help:
Toggles reflections quality.
Usage: r_ReflectionsQuality [0/1/2/3]
Default is 0 (terrain only), 1 (terrain + particles), 2 (terrain + particles + brushes), 3 (everything)

name: r_DetailTextures
help:
Toggles detail texture overlays.
Usage: r_DetailTextures [0/1]
Default is 1 (detail textures on).

name: r_ReloadShaders
help:
Reloads shaders.
Usage: r_ReloadShaders [0/1]
Default is 0. Set to 1 to reload shaders.

name: r_DetailDistance
help:
Distance used for per-pixel detail layers blending.
Usage: r_DetailDistance (1-20)
Default is 6.

name: r_TexBindMode
help:
Enable texture overrides.
Usage: r_TexBindMode [0/1/2/4/5/6/7/8/9/10/11]
	1 - Force gray non-font maps
	5 - Force flat normal maps
	6 - Force white diffuse maps
	7 - Force diffuse maps to use mipmapdebug texture
	8 - Colour code diffuse maps to show minimum uploaded mip [0:green,1:cyan,2:blue,3:purple,4:magenta,5:yellow,6:orange,7:red,higher:white]
	9 - Colour code diffuse maps to show textures streaming in in green and out in red
	10 - Colour code diffuse maps that have requested a lower mip than the lowest available [-3: red, -2: yellow, -1: green]
	11 - Force white diffuse map and flat normal map
	12 - Visualise textures that have more or less mips in memory than needed
	1xx - Force white also the secondary diffuse map
	13 - Surface type phys. debug color
	14 - Surface type movement speed
	16 - Diffuse mipmap usage vizualization [0:blue,1:cyan,2:green,3:yellow,higher:red]
Default is 0 (disabled).

name: r_NoDrawShaders
help:
Disable entire render pipeline.
Usage: r_NoDrawShaders [0/1]
Default is 0 (render pipeline enabled). Used for debugging and profiling.

name: r_DrawNearShadows
help:
Enable shadows for near objects.
Usage: r_DrawNearShadows [0/1]

name: r_NoDrawNear
help:
Disable drawing of near objects.
Usage: r_NoDrawNear [0/1]
Default is 0 (near objects are drawn).

name: r_DrawNearZRange
help: Default is 0.1.

name: r_DrawNearFarPlane
help: Default is 40.

name: r_DrawNearFoV
help:
Sets the FoV for drawing of near objects.
Usage: r_DrawNearFoV [n]
Default is 60.

name: r_Flares
help:
Toggles lens flare effect.
Usage: r_Flares [0/1]
Default is 1 (on).

name: r_FlareHqShafts
help:
Toggles high quality mode for point light shafts.
Usage: r_FlareHqShafts [0/1]
Default is 1 (on).

name: r_FlaresChromaShift
help:
Set flares chroma shift amount.
Usage: r_FlaresChromaShift [n]
Default is 6
0 Disables

name: r_FlaresIrisShaftMaxPolyNum
help:
Set the maximum number of polygon of IrisShaft.
Usage : r_FlaresIrisShaftMaxPolyNum [n]
Default is 200
0 Infinite

name: r_FlaresTessellationRatio
help:
Set the tessellation rate of flares. 1 is the original mesh.
Usage : r_FlaresTessellationRatio 0.5
Default is 1.0
Range is from 0 to 1

name: r_Gamma
help:
Adjusts the graphics card gamma correction (fast, needs hardware support, affects also HUD and desktop)
Usage: r_Gamma 1.0
1 off (default)

name: r_Brightness
help:
Sets the display brightness.
Usage: r_Brightness 0.5
Default is 0.5.

name: r_Contrast
help:
Sets the display contrast.
Usage: r_Contrast 0.5
Default is 0.5.

name: r_NoHWGamma
help:
Sets renderer to ignore hardware gamma correction.
Usage: r_NoHWGamma [0/1/2]
0 - allow hardware gamma correction
1 - disable hardware gamma correction
2 - disable hardware gamma correction in Editor

name: r_Scissor
help: Enables scissor test

name: r_wireframe
help: Toggles wireframe rendering mode

name: r_GetScreenShot
help:
To capture one screenshot (variable is set to 0 after capturing)
0=do not take a screenshot (default), 1=save a screenshot (together with .HDR if enabled), 2=save a screenshot

name: r_Log
help:
Logs rendering information to Direct3DLog.txt.
Use negative values to log a single frame.
Usage: r_Log +/-[0/1/2/3/4]
	1: Logs a list of all shaders without profile info.
	2: Log contains a list of all shaders with profile info.
	3: Logs all API function calls.
	4: Highly detailed pipeline log, including all passes,
			states, lights and pixel/vertex shaders.
Default is 0 (off). Use this function carefully, because
log files grow very quickly.

name: r_LogVidMem
help: Logs vid mem information to VidMemLog.txt.

name: r_Stats
help:
Toggles render statistics.
0=disabled,
1=global render stats,
2=print shaders for selected object,
3=CPU times of render passes and video memory usage,
4=CPU times of render passes,
5=Occlusion query calls (calls to mfDraw/mfReadResult_Now/mfReadResult_Try),
6=display per-instance drawcall count,
8=Info about instanced DIPs,
13=print info about cleared RT's,
Usage: r_Stats [0/1/n]

name: r_statsMinDrawCalls
help: Minimum drawcall amount to display for use with r_Stats 6

name: r_profiler
help:
Display render pipeline profiler.
  0: Disabled
  1: Basic overview
  2: Detailed pass stats

name: r_profilerTargetFPS
help: Target framerate for application.

name: r_VSync
help:
Toggles vertical sync.
0: Disabled
1: Enabled
2: Enabled, use asynchronous swaps on X360

name: r_overrideRefreshRate
help: Enforces specified refresh rate when running in fullscreen (0=off).

name: r_overrideScanlineOrder
help:
Enforces specified scanline order when running in fullscreen.
0=off,
1=progressive,
2=interlaced (upper field first),
3=interlaced (lower field first)
Usage: r_overrideScanlineOrder [0/1/2/3]

name: r_overrideDXGIOutput
help: Specifies index of display to use for output (0=primary display).

name: r_overrideDXGIOutputFS
help: Specifies index of display to use for full screen output (0=primary display).

name: r_FullscreenPreemption
help: While in fullscreen activities like notification pop ups of other applications won't cause a mode switch back into windowed mode.

name: r_PredicatedTiling
help:
Toggles predicated tiling mode (X360 only)
Usage: r_PredicatedTiling [0/1]

name: r_UseESRAM
help:
Toggles using ESRAM for render targets (Durango only)
Usage: r_UseESRAM [0/1]

name: r_MeasureOverdraw
help:
Activate a special rendering mode that visualize the rendering cost of each pixel by color.
0=off,
1=pixel shader instructions,
2=pass count,
3=vertex shader instructions,
4=overdraw estimation with 360 Hi-Z,
Usage: r_MeasureOverdraw [0/1/2/3/4]

name: r_BreakOnError
help: calls debugbreak on illegal behaviour

name: r_durango_async_dips
help: enables async dip submission on durango

name: r_durango_async_dips_sync
help: enables async dip submission sync on durango

name: r_ReprojectOnlyStaticObjects
help: Forces a split in the zpass, to prevent moving object from beeing reprojected

name: r_ReadZBufferDirectlyFromVMEM
help: Uses direct VMEM reads instead of a staging buffer on durango for the reprojection ZBuffer

name: r_ReverseDepth
help: Use 1-z depth rendering for increased depth precision

name: r_ShowTexture
help: Displays loaded texture - for debug purpose

name: r_ShaderEmailCCs
help:
Adds optional CC addresses to shader error emails
Usage: r_ShaderEmailCCs "email1@crytek.com;email2@crytek.com" 
Default is empty

name: r_ShaderCompilerDontCache
help:
Disables caching on server side.
Usage: r_ShaderCompilerDontCache 0 #
Default is 0

name: r_RC_AutoInvoke
help:
Enable calling the resource compiler (rc.exe) to compile assets at run-time if the date check
shows that the destination is older or does not exist.
Usage: r_RC_AutoInvoke 0 (default is 1)

name: r_NightVision
help:
Toggles nightvision enabling.
Usage: r_NightVision [0/1]
Default is 2 (HDR). Set to 1 (older version - kept for backward compatibility)Set to 3 to enable debug mode (force enabling).Set to 0 to completely disable nightvision.

name: r_NightVisionFinalMul
help: Set nightvision final color multiplier for fine tunning.

name: r_NightVisionBrightLevel
help: Set nightvision bloom brightlevel.

name: r_NightVisionSonarLifetime
help: Set nightvision sonar hints lifetime.

name: r_NightVisionSonarMultiplier
help: Set nightvision sonar hints color multiplier.

name: r_NightVisionSonarRadius
help: Set nightvision sonar hints radius.

name: r_NightVisionCamMovNoiseAmount
help: Set nightvision noise amount based on camera movement.

name: r_NightVisionCamMovNoiseBlendSpeed
help: Set nightvision noise amount blend speed.

name: r_dofMinZ
help: Set dof min z distance, anything behind this distance will get out focus. (good default value 0.4)

name: r_dofMinZScale
help: Set dof min z out of focus strenght (good default value - 1.0f)

name: r_dofMinZBlendMult
help: Set dof min z blend multiplier (bigger value means faster blendind transition)

name: r_DepthOfFieldDilation
help: Sets dilation width to reduce ghosting artifacts on near objects (can introduce other artifacts)

name: r_SonarVision
help:
Toggles sonar vision enabling.
Usage: r_SonarVision [0/1]
Default is 1 (on). Set to 2 to enable debug mode (force enabling). Set to 0 to completely disable sonar vision modes.

name: r_ThermalVision
help:
Toggles termal vision enabling.
Usage: r_ThermalVision [0/1]
Default is 1 (on). Set to 2 to enable debug mode (force enabling). Set to 0 to completely disable termal vision modes.

name: r_ThermalVisionViewCloakFrequencyPrimary
help:
Sets thermal vision cloaked-object flicker primary frequency.
Usage: r_ThermalVisionViewCloakFrequencyPrimary [1+]
When looking at a refracting (cloaked) object sets the inverse frequency of the primary sine wave for the objects heat. Higher = slower

name: r_ThermalVisionViewCloakFrequencySecondary
help:
Sets thermal vision cloaked-object flicker secondary frequency.
Usage: r_ThermalVisionViewCloakFrequencySecondary [1+]
When looking at a refracting (cloaked) object sets the inverse frequency of the secondary sine wave for the objects heat. Higher = slower

name: r_ThermalVisionViewCloakFlickerMinIntensity
help:
Sets thermal vision cloaked-object flicker random min intensity.
Usage: r_ThermalVisionViewCloakFlickerMinIntensity [0.0+]
When looking at a refracting (cloaked) object sets the min scaling factor at which the object displays hot in thermal vision

name: r_ThermalVisionViewCloakFlickerMaxIntensity
help:
Sets thermal vision cloaked-object flicker random max intensity.
Usage: r_ThermalVisionViewCloakFlickerMaxIntensity [0.0+]
When looking at a refracting (cloaked) object sets the min scaling factor at which the object displays hot in thermal vision

name: r_Refraction
help:
Enables refraction.
Usage: r_Refraction [0/1]
Default is 1 (on). Set to 0 to disable.

name: r_sunshafts
help:
Enables sun shafts.
Usage: r_sunshafts [0/1]
Default is 1 (on). Set to 0 to disable.

name: r_PostProcessEffects
help:
Enables post processing special effects.
Usage: r_PostProcessEffects [0/1/2]
Default is 1 (enabled). 2 enables and displays active effects

name: r_PostProcessParamsBlending
help:
Enables post processing effects parameters smooth blending
Usage: r_PostProcessEffectsParamsBlending [0/1]
Default is 1 (enabled).

name: r_PostprocessParamsBlendingTimeScale
help:
Sets post processing effects parameters smooth blending time scale
Usage: r_PostprocessParamsBlendingTimeScale [scale]
Default is 12.0f.

name: r_PostProcessFilters
help:
Enables post processing special effects filters.
Usage: r_PostProcessEffectsFilters [0/1]
Default is 1 (enabled). 0 disabled

name: r_PostProcessGameFx
help:
Enables post processing special effects game fx.
Usage: r_PostProcessEffectsGameFx [0/1]
Default is 1 (enabled). 0 disabled

name: r_PostProcessReset
help:
Enables post processing special effects reset.
Usage: r_PostProcessEffectsReset [0/1]
Default is 0 (disabled). 1 enabled

name: r_MergeShadowDrawcalls
help:
Enabled Merging of RenderChunks for ShadowRendering
Default is 1 (enabled). 0 disabled

name: r_PostProcessHUD3D
help:
Toggles 3d hud post processing.
Usage: r_PostProcessHUD3D [0/1]
Default is 1 (post process hud enabled). 0 Disabled

name: r_PostProcessHUD3DDebugView
help:
Debug views for 3d hud post processing.
Usage: CV_r_PostProcessHUD3DDebugView [0/1/2/3]
Default is 0 (disabled). 1 Solid fill. 2 Wire frame. 3 Unwrap mesh onto flash texture

name: r_PostProcessHUD3DCache
help:
Enables 3d hud caching overframes.
Usage: r_PostProcessHUD3DCache [0/1/2/3]
Default is 0 (disabled). 1 Cache every 1 frame. 2 Every 2 frames. Etc

name: r_PostProcessHUD3DShadowAmount
help:
Controls 3D HUD 'Shadow' Amount.
Usage: r_PostProcessHUD3DShadowAmount [> 0.0]
Default is 1.7f, higher = darker

name: r_PostProcessHUD3DGlowAmount
help:
Controls 3D HUD 'Glow' Amount.
Usage: r_PostProcessHUD3DGlowAmount [> 0.0]
Default is 1.0f, higher = more glow

name: r_PostProcessHUD3DStencilClear
help:
Enables stencil clears for flash masks when rendering HUD in 3D post process.
Usage: r_PostProcessHUD3DNoStencilClear [0/1]
Default is 1 (enabled), 0 disabled

name: r_PostProcessNanoGlassDebugView
help:
Debug views for Nano Glass post processing.
Usage: CV_r_PostProcessNanoGlassDebugView [0/1]
Default is 0 (disabled). 1 Wire frame.

name: r_ColorRangeCompression
help:
Enables color range compression to account for the limited RGB range of TVs.
  0: Disabled (full extended range)
  1: Range 16-235

name: r_ColorGrading
help:
Enables color grading.
Usage: r_ColorGrading [0/1]

name: r_ColorGradingSelectiveColor
help:
Enables color grading.
Usage: r_ColorGradingSelectiveColor [0/1]

name: r_ColorGradingLevels
help:
Enables color grading.
Usage: r_ColorGradingLevels [0/1]

name: r_ColorGradingFilters
help:
Enables color grading.
Usage: r_ColorGradingFilters [0/1]

name: r_ColorGradingCharts
help:
Enables color grading via color charts.
Usage: r_ColorGradingCharts [0/1]

name: r_ColorGradingChartsCache
help:
Enables color grading charts update caching.
Usage: r_ColorGradingCharts [0/1/2/etc]
Default is 4 (update every 4 frames), 0 - always update, 1- update every other frame

name: r_CloudsUpdateAlways
help:
Toggles updating of clouds each frame.
Usage: r_CloudsUpdateAlways [0/1]
Default is 0 (off)

name: r_CloudsDebug
help:
Toggles debugging mode for clouds.Usage: r_CloudsDebug [0/1/2]
Usage: r_CloudsDebug = 1: render just screen imposters
Usage: r_CloudsDebug = 2: render just non-screen imposters
Default is 0 (off)

name: r_buffer_banksize
help: the bank size in MB for buffer pooling

name: r_constantbuffer_banksize
help: the bank size in MB for constant buffers pooling

name: r_constantbuffer_watermarm
help: the threshold aftyer which constants buffers will reclaim memory

name: r_buffer_sli_workaround
help: enable SLI workaround for buffer pooling

name: r_transient_pool_size
help: the bank size in MB for the transient pool

name: r_buffer_enable_lockless_updates
help: enable/disable lockless buffer updates on platforms that support them

name: r_enable_full_gpu_sync
help: enable full gpu synchronization for debugging purposes on the every buffer I/O operation (debugging only)

name: r_buffer_pool_max_allocs
help: the maximum number of allocations per buffer pool if defragmentation is enabled

name: r_buffer_pool_defrag_static
help: enable/disable runtime defragmentation of static buffers

name: r_buffer_pool_defrag_dynamic
help: enable/disable runtime defragmentation of dynamic buffers

name: r_buffer_pool_defrag_max_moves
help: maximum number of moves the defragmentation system is allowed to perform per frame

name: r_TexMinAnisotropy
help:
Specifies the minimum level allowed for anisotropic texture filtering.
0(default) means abiding by the filtering setting in each material, except possibly being capped by r_TexMaxAnisotropy.

name: r_TexMaxAnisotropy
help: Specifies the maximum level allowed for anisotropic texture filtering.

name: r_TexNoAnisoAlphaTest
help: Disables anisotropic filtering on alpha-tested geometry like vegetation.

name: r_TexLog
help:
Configures texture information logging.
Usage:	r_TexLog #
where # represents:
	0: Texture logging off
	1: Texture information logged to screen
	2: All loaded textures logged to 'UsedTextures.txt'
	3: Missing textures logged to 'MissingTextures.txt

name: r_TexNoLoad
help:
Disables loading of textures.
Usage:	r_TexNoLoad [0/1]
When 1 texture loading is disabled.

name: r_RenderTargetPoolSize
help:
Size of pool for render targets in MB.
Default is 50(MB).

name: r_texturesstreampooldefragmentation
help: Enabled CPU (1), GPU(2) and disable (0) textures stream pool defragmentation.

name: r_texturesstreampooldefragmentationmaxmoves
help: Specify the maximum number of blocks to move per defragmentation update

name: r_texturesstreampooldefragmentationmaxamount
help: Specify the limit (in bytes) that defrag update will stop

name: r_texturesskiplowermips
help: Enabled skipping lower mips for X360.

name: r_TexturesStreamPoolSize
help: Size of texture streaming pool in MB.

name: r_TexturesStreamPoolSecondarySize
help: Size of secondary pool for textures in MB.

name: r_TexturesStreamingSync
help:
Force only synchronous texture streaming.
All textures will be streamed in the main thread. Useful for debug purposes.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingSync [0/1]
Default is 0 (off).

name: r_TexturesStreamingResidencyEnabled
help:
Toggle for resident textures streaming support.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingResidencyEnabled [toggle]Default is 0, 1 for enabled

name: r_TexturesStreamingResidencyTimeTestLimit
help:
Time limit to use for mip thrashing calculation in seconds.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingResidencyTimeTestLimit [time]Default is 5 seconds

name: r_TexturesStreamingResidencyTime
help:
Time to keep textures resident for before allowing them to be removed from memory.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingResidencyTime [Time]
Default is 10 seconds

name: r_TexturesStreamingResidencyThrottle
help:
Ratio for textures to become resident.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingResidencyThrottle [ratio]Default is 0.5Max is 1.0 means textures will become resident sooner, Min 0.0 means textures will not become resident

name: r_TexturesStreamingMaxRequestedMB
help:
Maximum amount of texture data requested from streaming system in MB.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingMaxRequestedMB [size]
Default is 20.0(MB)

name: r_TexturesStreamingPostponeMips
help:
Postpone loading of high res mipmaps to improve resolution ballance of texture streaming.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingPostponeMips [0/1]
Default is 1 (on).

name: r_TexturesStreamingPostponeThresholdKB
help:
Threshold used to postpone high resolution mipmap loads in KB.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingPostponeThresholdKB [size]
Default is 1024(KB)

name: r_texturesstreamingPostponeThresholdMip
help:
Threshold used to postpone high resolution mipmaps.
Usage: r_texturesstreamingPostponeThresholdMip [count]
Default is 1

name: r_TexturesStreamingMinReadSizeKB
help:
Minimal read portion in KB.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingMinReadSizeKB [size]
Default is 32(KB)

name: r_texturesstreamingSkipMips
help: Number of top mips to ignore when streaming.

name: r_texturesstreamingMinUsableMips
help: Minimum number of mips a texture should be able to use after applying r_texturesstreamingSkipMips.

name: r_texturesstreamingJobUpdate
help: Enable texture streaming update job

name: r_texturesstreamingDeferred
help: When enabled textures will be uploaded through a deferred context.

name: r_TexturesStreamingMaxRequestedJobs
help:
Maximum number of tasks submitted to streaming system.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingMaxRequestedJobs [jobs number]
Default is 32 jobs

name: r_TexturesStreamingUpdateType
help:
Texture streaming update type.
Default is 0

name: r_TexturesStreamingPrecacheRounds
help:
Number of precache rounds to include in active streamed texture lists.
Default is 1

name: r_TexturesStreamingSuppress
help:
Force unloading of all textures and suppress new stream tasks.
Default is 0

name: r_TexturesStreamingMipBias
help:
Controls how texture LOD depends from distance to the objects.
Increasing this value will reduce amount of memory required for textures.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingMipBias [-4..0..4]
Default is 0.

name: r_TexturesStreamingMipClampDVD
help:
Clamp the texture mip level to certain value when streaming from DVD. 1 will never allow highest mips to be loaded for example.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingMipClampDVD [0..4]
Default is 1.

name: r_TexturesStreamingDisableNoStreamDuringLoad
help: Load time optimisation. When enabled, textures flagged as non-streaming will still be streamed during level load, but will have a high priority stream request added in RT_Precache. Once streamed in, the texture will remain resident

name: r_TexturesStreamingMipFading
help:
Controls how the new texture MIP appears after being streamed in.
This variable influences only a visual quality of appearing texture details.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingMipFading [0/1]
Default is 1 (enabled).

name: r_TexturesStreamingNoUpload
help:
Disable uploading data into texture from system memory. Useful for debug purposes.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingNoUpload [0/1]
Default is 0 (off).

name: r_TexturesStreamingOnlyVideo
help:
Don't store system memory copy of texture. Applicable only for PC.
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingOnlyVideo [0/1]
Default is 0 (off).

name: r_TexturesStreaming
help:
Enables direct streaming of textures from disk during game.
Usage: r_TexturesStreaming [0/1/2]
Default is 0 (off). All textures save in native format with mips in a
cache file. Textures are then loaded into texture memory from the cache.

name: r_TexturesStreamingDebug
help:
Enables textures streaming debug mode. (Log uploads and remove unnecessary mip levels)
Usage: r_TexturesStreamingDebug [0/1/2]
Default is 0 (off).1 - texture streaming log.2 - Show textures hit-parade based on streaming priorities3 - Show textures hit-parade based on the memory consumed

name: r_TexturesStreamingDebugFilter
help: Filters displayed textures by name in texture streaming debug mode

name: r_ShowLightBounds
help:
Display light bounds - for debug purpose
Usage: r_ShowLightBounds [0=off/1=on]

name: r_ParticlesTessellation
help: Enables particle tessellation for higher quality lighting. (DX11 only)

name: r_ParticlesTessellationTriSize
help: Sets particles tessellation triangle screen space size in pixels (DX11 only)

name: r_ZFightingDepthScale
help: Controls anti z-fighting measures in shaders (scaling homogeneous z).

name: r_ZFightingExtrude
help: Controls anti z-fighting measures in shaders (extrusion along normal in world units).

name: r_TexelsPerMeter
help:
Enables visualization of the color coded "texels per meter" ratio for objects in view.
The checkerboard pattern displayed represents the mapping of the assigned diffuse
texture onto the object's uv space. One block in the pattern represents 8x8 texels.
Usage: r_TexelsPerMeter [n] (where n is the desired number of texels per meter; 0 = off)

name: r_enableAltTab
help:
Toggles alt tabbing in and out of fullscreen when the game is not in devmode.
Usage: r_enableAltTab [toggle]
Notes: Should only be added to system.cfg and requires a restart

name: r_StereoDevice
help:
Sets stereo device (only possible before app start)
Usage: r_StereoDevice [0/1/2/3/4]
0: No stereo support (default)
1: Frame compatible formats (side-by-side, interlaced, anaglyph)
2: HDMI 1.4
3: Stereo driver (PC only, NVidia or AMD)
4: Dualhead (PC only, two projectors or iZ3D screen)
100: Auto-detect device for platform

name: r_StereoMode
help:
Sets stereo rendering mode.
Usage: r_StereoMode [0=off/1/2]
1: Dual rendering
2: Post Stereo

name: r_StereoOutput
help:
Sets stereo output. Output depends on the stereo monitor
Usage: r_StereoOutput [0=off/1/2/3/4/5/6/...]
0: Standard
1: IZ3D
2: Checkerboard (not supported on X360)
3: Above and Below (not supported)
4: Side by Side
5: Line by Line (Interlaced)
6: Anaglyph
7: Oculus

name: r_StereoFlipEyes
help:
Flip eyes in stereo mode.
Usage: r_StereoFlipEyes [0=off/1=on]
0: don't flip
1: flip

name: r_stereoScaleCoefficient
help: Multiplier which influences the perceived scale of the world in VR (1.f = no effect, 0.25 = you are about 1/4th the size).

name: r_StereoStrength
help: Multiplier which influences the strength of the stereo effect.

name: r_StereoEyeDist
help: [For 3D TV] Maximum separation between stereo images in percentage of the screen.

name: r_StereoScreenDist
help: Distance to plane where stereo parallax converges to zero.

name: r_StereoNearGeoScale
help: Scale for near geometry (weapon) that gets pushed into the screen

name: r_StereoHudScreenDist
help:
Distance to plane where hud stereo parallax converges to zero.
If not zero, HUD needs to be rendered two times.

name: r_StereoGammaAdjustment
help:
Additional adjustment to the graphics card gamma correction when Stereo is enabled.
Usage: r_StereoGammaAdjustment [offset]0: off

name: r_ConsoleBackbufferWidth
help: console specific backbuffer resolution - width

name: r_ConsoleBackbufferHeight
help: console specific backbuffer resolution - height

name: r_ConditionalRendering
help: Enables conditional rendering .

name: r_CustomResMaxSize
help: Maximum resolution of custom resolution rendering

name: r_CustomResWidth
help: Width of custom resolution rendering

name: r_CustomResHeight
help: Height of custom resolution rendering

name: r_CustomResPreview
help: Enable/disable preview of custom resolution rendering in viewport(0 - no preview, 1 - scaled to match viewport, 2 - custom resolution clipped to viewport

name: r_Supersampling
help: Use supersampled antialiasing(1 - 1x1 no SSAA, 2 - 2x2, 3 - 3x3 ...)

name: r_SupersamplingFilter
help:
Filter method to use when resolving supersampled output
0 - Box filter
1 - Tent filter
2 - Gaussian filter
3 - Lanczos filter

name: r_TextureCompressor
help:
Defines which texture compressor is used (fallback is DirectX)
Usage: r_TextureCompressor [0/1]
0 uses DirectX, 1 uses squish if possible

name: r_FogDepthTest
help:
Enables per-pixel culling for deferred volumetric fog pass.
Fog computations for all pixels closer than a given depth value will be skipped.
Usage: r_FogDepthTest z with...
  z = 0, culling disabled
  z > 0, fixed linear world space culling depth
  z < 0, optimal culling depth will be computed automatically based on camera direction and fog settings

name: r_FogMinDensityMasked
help: Minimum fog density required for forced rain occ. mask generation.

name: r_FogShadows
help:
Enables deferred volumetric fog shadows
Usage: r_FogShadows [0/1/2]
  0: off
  1: standard resolution
  2: reduced resolution

name: r_FogShadowsMode
help:
Ray-casting mode for shadowed fog
Usage: r_FogShadowsMode [0/1]
  0: brute force shadowmap sampling
  1: optimized shadowmap sampling

name: r_FogShadowsWater
help: Enables volumetric fog shadows for watervolumes

name: r_RainDropsEffect
help:
Enable RainDrops effect.
Usage: r_RainDropEffect [0/1/2]
0: force off
1: on (default)
2: on (forced)

name: r_RefractionPartialResolves
help:
Do a partial screen resolve before refraction
Usage: r_RefractionPartialResolves [0/1]
0: disable 
1: enable conservatively (non-optimal)
2: enable (default)

name: r_RefractionPartialResolvesDebug
help:
Toggle refraction partial resolves debug display
Usage: r_RefractionPartialResolvesDebug [0/1]
0: disable 
1: Additive 2d area 
2: Bounding boxes 
3: Alpha overlay with varying colours

name: r_Batching
help:
Enable/disable render items batching
Usage: r_Batching [0/1]

name: r_Unlit
help: Render just diffuse texture with no lighting (for most materials).

name: r_HideSunInCubemaps
help: Stops the sun being drawn during cubemap generation.

name: r_FlashMatTexResQuality
help:
Texture resolution quality of flash materials.
Only used if flash asset is tagged CE_HQR!

name: r_DynTexSourceSharedRTWidth
help: Width override for shared RT for dynamic texture sources. Takes effect when bigger than 0.

name: r_DynTexSourceSharedRTHeight
help: Height override of shared RT for dynamic texture sources. Takes effect when bigger than 0.

name: r_DynTexSourceUseSharedRT
help:
Defines if dynamic flash textures are rendered into shared RT
Usage: r_DynTexSourceUseSharedRT [0/1].
0: Use Unique RT for each dynamic flash texture (with alpha support)
1: Use Shared RT for all dynamic flash textures (no alpha support!)
Disabled by default. Requires level reload to change.

name: r_OverscanBorderScaleX
help:
Sets the overscan border width scale
Usage: r_OverscanBorderScaleX [0.0->0.25]

name: r_OverscanBorderScaleY
help:
Sets the overscan border height scale
Usage: r_OverscanBorderScaleY [0.0->0.25]

name: r_UsePersistentRTForModelHUD
help: Uses a seperate RT to render models for the ModelHud Renderer

name: r_ParticleVerticePoolSize
help: Max Number of Particle Vertices to support

name: r_ParticlesDebug
help:
Particles debugging
Usage: 
0 disabled
1 particles screen coverage (red = bad, blue = good)
2 particles overdraw (white = really bad, red = bad, blue = good)

name: r_GeomCacheInstanceThreshold
help: Threshold after which instancing is used to draw geometry cache pieces

name: r_VisAreaClipLightsPerPixel
help: Per pixel light/cubemap culling for vis areas: 0=off, 1=on

name: r_VolumetricFogTexScale
help:
Width and height scale factor (divided by screen resolution) for volume texture.
Acceptable value is more than equal 2.

name: r_VolumetricFogTexDepth
help:
Depth resolution of volume texture.
Huge value runs out of performance and video memory.

name: r_VolumetricFogReprojectionBlendFactor
help:
Adjust the blend factor of temporal reprojection.
Acceptable value is between 0 and 1.
0 means temporal reprojecton is off.

name: r_VolumetricFogSample
help:
Adjust number of sample points.
0: 1 sample point in a voxel
1: 2 sample points in a voxel
2: 4 sample points in a voxel

name: r_VolumetricFogShadow
help:
Adjust shadow sample count per sample point.
0: 1 shadow sample per sample point
1: 2 shadow samples per sample point 
2: 3 shadow samples per sample point
3: 4 shadow samples per sample point

name: r_VolumetricFogDownscaledSunShadow
help:
Enable replacing sun shadow maps with downscaled shadow maps or static shadow map if possible.
0: disabled
1: replace first and second cascades with downscaled shadow maps. the others are replaced with static shadow map if possible.
2: replace first, second, and third cascades with downscaled shadow maps. the others are replaced with static shadow map if possible.

name: r_VolumetricFogDownscaledSunShadowRatio
help:
Set downscale ratio for sun shadow maps
0: 1/4 downscaled sun shadow maps
1: 1/8 downscaled sun shadow maps
2: 1/16 downscaled sun shadow maps

name: r_VolumetricFogReprojectionMode
help:
Set the mode of ghost reduction for temporal reprojection.
0: conservative
1: advanced

name: r_VolumetricFogMinimumLightBulbSize
help: Adjust the minimum size threshold for light attenuation bulb size. Small bulb size causes the light flicker.

name: r_VolumetricFogSunLightCorrection
help:
Enables the correction of sun light luminance. Volumetric fog gets brighter but it's consistent with other lighting.
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled.

name: wh_r_OrthoCameraEnabled
help: Orthogonal camera

name: wh_r_OrthoCameraScale
help: Scale of orthogonal camera

name: r_MouseCursorTexture
help: Sets the image (dds file) to be displayed as the mouse cursor

name: q_ShaderGeneral
help:
Defines the shader quality of General
Usage: q_ShaderGeneral 0=low/1=med/2=high/3=very high (default)

name: q_ShaderMetal
help:
Defines the shader quality of Metal
Usage: q_ShaderMetal 0=low/1=med/2=high/3=very high (default)

name: q_ShaderGlass
help:
Defines the shader quality of Glass
Usage: q_ShaderGlass 0=low/1=med/2=high/3=very high (default)

name: q_ShaderVegetation
help:
Defines the shader quality of Vegetation
Usage: q_ShaderVegetation 0=low/1=med/2=high/3=very high (default)

name: q_ShaderIce
help:
Defines the shader quality of Ice
Usage: q_ShaderIce 0=low/1=med/2=high/3=very high (default)

name: q_ShaderTerrain
help:
Defines the shader quality of Terrain
Usage: q_ShaderTerrain 0=low/1=med/2=high/3=very high (default)

name: q_ShaderShadow
help:
Defines the shader quality of Shadow
Usage: q_ShaderShadow 0=low/1=med/2=high/3=very high (default)

name: q_ShaderWater
help:
Defines the shader quality of Water
Usage: q_ShaderWater 0=low/1=med/2=high/3=very high (default)

name: q_ShaderFX
help:
Defines the shader quality of FX
Usage: q_ShaderFX 0=low/1=med/2=high/3=very high (default)

name: q_ShaderPostProcess
help:
Defines the shader quality of PostProcess
Usage: q_ShaderPostProcess 0=low/1=med/2=high/3=very high (default)

name: q_ShaderHDR
help:
Defines the shader quality of HDR
Usage: q_ShaderHDR 0=low/1=med/2=high/3=very high (default)

name: q_ShaderSky
help:
Defines the shader quality of Sky
Usage: q_ShaderSky 0=low/1=med/2=high/3=very high (default)

name: q_Renderer
help:
Defines the quality of Renderer
Usage: q_Renderer 0=low/1=med/2=high/3=very high (default)

name: net_lobby_default_port
help: Modify the default port for lobbies (effects LAN Lobby currently)

name: net_useSteamAsOnlineLobby
help: Defines if steam should be used or not

name: net_steam_resetAchievements
help: if set to 1, it will reset achievements for Steam on app start

name: sv_autoconfigurl
help: Automatically download configuration data from a URL

name: net_log
help: Logging level of network system

name: net_inactivitytimeout
help: Sets how many seconds without receiving a packet a connection will stay alive for (can only be set on server)

name: net_inactivitytimeoutDevmode
help: Sets how many seconds without receiving a packet a connection will stay alive for while in devmode (can only be set on server)

name: net_lan_scanport_first
help: Starting port for LAN games scanning

name: net_lan_scanport_num
help: Num ports for LAN games scanning

name: net_stats_login
help: Login for reporting stats on dedicated server

name: net_stats_pass
help: Password for reporting stats on dedicated server

name: net_numNetIDLowBitBits
help: Number of bits used for low bit NetIDs. By default players start allocating from low bit NetIDs.

name: net_numNetIDMediumBitBits
help: Number of bits used for medium bit NetIDs. By default dynamic entities start allocating from medium bit NetIDs.

name: net_numNetIDHighBitBits
help: Number of bits used for high bit NetIDs. By default static entities start allocating from high bit NetIDs.

name: lua_debugger
help:
Enables the script debugger.
1 to trigger on breakpoints and errors
2 to only trigger on errors
Usage: lua_debugger [0/1/2]

name: lua_StopOnError
help: Stops on error

name: lua_CodeCoverage
help: Enables code coverage

name: wh_lua_better_print
help: Turns on (1) or off (0) improved print command in lua.

name: lua_stackonmalloc
help: Enables/disables logging of the called lua functions and respective callstacks, whenever a new lua object is instantiated.

name: s_ATLPoolSize
help:
Specifies the size (in KiB) of the memory pool to be used by the ATL.
Usage: s_ATLPoolSize [0/...]
Default PC: 8192 (8 MiB), XboxOne: 8192 (8 MiB), PS4: 8192 (8 MiB), Mac: 8192 (8 MiB), Linux: 8192 (8 MiB), iOS: 8192 (8 MiB), Android: 4096 (4 MiB)

name: s_OcclusionMaxDistance
help:
Obstruction/Occlusion is not calculated for the sounds, whose distance to the listener is greater than this value. Setting this value to 0 disables obstruction/occlusion calculations.
Usage: s_OcclusionMaxDistance [0/...]
Default: 500 m

name: s_OcclusionMaxSyncDistance
help:
Physics rays are processed synchronously for the sounds that are closer to the listener than this value, and asynchronously for the rest (possible performance optimization).
Usage: s_OcclusionMaxSyncDistance [0/...]
Default: 10 m

name: s_FullObstructionMaxDistance
help:
for the sounds, whose distance to the listener is greater than this value, the obstruction is value gets attenuated with distance.
Usage: s_FullObstructionMaxDistance [0/...]
Default: 5 m

name: s_PositionUpdateThreshold
help:
An audio object has to move by at least this amount to issue a position update request to the audio system.
This kind of optimization should ideally be done by the parent system so this is here for convenience.Usage: s_PositionUpdateThreshold [0/...]
Default: 0.1 (10 cm)

name: s_VelocityTrackingThreshold
help:
An audio object has to change its velocity by at least this amount to issue an "object_speed" RTPC update request to the audio system.
Usage: s_VelocityTrackingThreshold [0/...]
Default: 0.1 (10 cm/s)

name: s_FileCacheManagerSize
help:
Sets the size in KiB the AFCM will allocate on the heap.
Usage: s_FileCacheManagerSize [0/...]
Default PC: 393216 (384 MiB), XboxOne: 393216 (384 MiB), PS4: 393216 (384 MiB), Mac: 393216 (384 MiB), Linux: 393216 (384 MiB), iOS: 2048 (2 MiB), Android: 73728 (72 MiB)

name: s_AudioObjectPoolSize
help:
Sets the number of preallocated audio objects and corresponding audio proxies.
Usage: s_AudioObjectPoolSize [0/...]
Default PC: 256, XboxOne: 256, PS4: 256, Mac: 256, Linux: 256, iOS: 256, Android: 256

name: s_AudioEventPoolSize
help:
Sets the number of preallocated audio events.
Usage: s_AudioEventPoolSize [0/...]
Default PC: 256, XboxOne: 256, PS4: 256, Mac: 256, Linux: 256, iOS: 256, Android: 256

name: s_AudioStandaloneFilePoolSize
help:
Sets the number of preallocated audio standalone files.
Usage: s_AudioStandaloneFilePoolSize [0/...]
Default PC: 0, XboxOne: 0, PS4: 0, Mac: 0, Linux: 0, iOS: 0, Android: 0

name: s_AudioProxiesInitType
help:
Can override AudioProxies' init type on a global scale.
If set it determines whether AudioProxies initialize synchronously or asynchronously.
This is a performance type cvar as asynchronously initializing AudioProxies
will have a greatly reduced impact on the calling thread.
Be aware though that when set to initialize asynchronously that audio will play back delayed.
By how much will greatly depend on the audio thread's work load.
0: AudioProxy specific initialization.
1: All AudioProxies initialize synchronously.
2: All AudioProxies initialize asynchronously.
Usage: s_AudioProxiesInitType [0/1/2]
Default PC: 0, XboxOne: 0, PS4: 0, Mac: 0, Linux: 0, iOS: 0, Android: 0

name: wh_s_OcclusionRayEnabled
help:
Enables or disables obstruction system using ray casts.Usage: wh_s_OcclusionRayEnabled [0/1]
Default: 0 (disabled)

name: s_AudioSystemImplementationName
help:
Holds the name of the AudioSystemImplementation library to be used.
Usage: s_AudioSystemImplementationName <name of the library without extension>
Default: CryAudioImplWwise

name: wh_snd_audio_xmls_dir
help: Path to the sound XMLs

name: p_DLCDebug
help: Enable debug for DLC manager.

name: p_DLCDRegionCount
help: Num of regions enumerated when searching for DLC's

name: wh_dlc_FakeLicense
help: comma separated numeric IDs of DLCs. Or use * to fake all licenses. If empty real license is used.

name: wh_g_showHelp
help: Enables help display.

name: wh_sys_SQLServer
help: SQL server name

name: wh_sys_SQLDatabase
help: SQL database name

name: wh_sys_SQLUser
help: SQL user name

name: wh_sys_SQLPassword
help: SQL user password

name: wh_sys_SQLBranch
help: SQL branch name

name: wh_sys_SQLWritable
help: if SQL is writable

name: wh_sys_AutoPatchDB
help: autopatching of tables by XML

name: wh_sys_PreferredDB
help: Comma separated list of DB serializers (XML, SQL, TBL)

name: wh_sys_BuildInfo
help: Build info displayed in menu

name: wh_sys_DoCrash
help: Intentional crash

name: wh_sys_DoFatalError
help: Intentional fatal error

name: wh_sys_RandomSeed
help: Seed for random generator. If seed < 0, seed is generated from time

name: crysis
help: ?and
